tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag chen mo dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bde chen kun bzang sku gsung thugs snying gsang ba mchog dgyes 'og min zhing na gdod nas bzhugs pa'i sku// stong nyid snang brnyan dkyil 'khor so sor zhi khro rab 'byams cir yang ston pa'i sgyu ma'i mkhan po nyid// sna tshogs zhing du shākya'i tog dang klu sgrub la sogs mchog dang mchog min dpag med sprul pa'ang 'gyed// yan lag bdun ldan rigs brgya'i bdag po dkyil 'khor kun gtso rdo rje 'chang la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo// til rdung zil gyis snying po'i don rtogs bhaṅga la ru sangs rgyas dang mjal bka' bab bzhi ldan shes rab bzang po til+li pa// lnga rig paṇa chen snyan grags bzang po byang phyogs sgo srung bcu gnyis dka' spyad grub pa'i sar bzhugs ye shes dngos grub nā ro pa// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gsang sngags 'chad nyan sgrub pa'i lag len sngon med srol 'byed 'jig rten mig gcig lo tsā'i mchog gyur mar pa'i mtshan// snyigs dus 'gro la mig ltos 'jog phyir dka' spyad sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mngon gyur mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la'ang snying nas 'dud// zla 'od gzhon nu'i smon lam shing rtas gangs can mkha' la spyan drangs gyur pa'i tsha zer 'bum phrag can// gang gi 'dun na chen po gsum grags glog dang skar ma zla ba'ang mi mngon khyodanyid gcig pu yis// mdo rgyud man ngag gling bzhi kun la khyab byed lam ston skye dgu'i snying gi mun pa sel byed mkhan// chos kyi nyi mar rgyal bas lung bstan dge slong 'tsho byed sgam po pa de snying gi dkyil du bsten// so thar tshul khrims yu ba mkhrang pos gyen du bteg pa'i lung rigs man ngag bgrang bas rtsibs kyi steng*// bir+wa'i lam skor rgyas pa la sogs rma bya'i sgro ris 'bum gyis bkra ba'i gur khyim yangs par phub// byang sems sham bus 'khor yug mdzes pa'i tog gi yang rtser phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i rdo rje rgyal// srid pa gsum gyi tsha gdung skyob byed 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa snyan grags gdugs 'dzin bstod// bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom gsum srog shing 'bri gung se ba'i gling mchog byin rlabs te// skyu ra'i rigs 'khrungs rnga chen mdo dang pad+ma'i bka' sogs lung bstan dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo ba gang de'i rtse mo la// lnga ldan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal pos gdul bya'i yid kyi re ba dus su bskong mdzad pa// li tsa gzhon nu klu sgrub skye mtha' rin chen dpal mtshan 'jig rten gsum mgon rgyal mtshan mngon par mtho// sham+bha la ru shākya'i rigs las rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal srid skyong rnams rim par byon ltar zhing khams 'dir na skyu ra'i gdung las 'bri gung chos kyi khri 'phang mthor 'dzeg rgyal ba nyid kyi sprul pa ni// sangs rgyas dbon chen bsod nams grags dang rgyal ba'i gcung po rdo rje grags te rgyal sras thog kha rin chen seng ge spyan snga mtshams bcad grags pa bsod nams bcu gnyis par grags rdo rje rin chen mtshan rnams dang*// me trai'i sprul pa nyer brgyad par grags rdo rje rgyal dang 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol nyer gnyis pa ste don grub rgyal po bco lnga pa dang waṃ rin chen dang chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po// rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal dang rin chen rgyal po dbang gi mtshan dang slar yang skyob pa nyid kyi sprul par khri thog bcu gsum dus su zhal bzhes kun dga' rin chen zhabs kyi pad+mor rtag tu 'dud// rdo rje 'chang dbang zhal gyi 'chi med bcud// til+li'i rkang 'thung dpag bsam la sim pa// nā ro lha brgya'i zas kyi bya ma rtas// mar pa'i skal bzang lag par phangs med byin// de nas mi la zhes bya'i drang srong gis// sgrin 'grus hub thebs gcig gis mgrin par myangs// dbus pa ston pa zhes bya'i lhag bsam gyis// lha min rus bu 'khrud phyir gsol ba btab// dus der lta spyod byin rlabs rgyun gsum pa// dwags po bka' brgyud dza hu'i bu mo zhes// gaṅgā phyag rgya chen por grags 'di'o// khams pa mi gsum nang nas 'gro mgon gyis// yongs rdzogs bstan pa 'bri gung pa la gtad// ti se tsā ri la sogs gnas chen dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul la mnga' bsgyur mkhan// zhing srung tshul gyi bstan pa spel zhus par// lung bstan 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon po// gang des sngon gyi rgyal po zla bzang ltar// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' bsdu dgongs gcig dang*// sngon med bkra shis sgo mang blos bslangs che// phrin las rnam bzhis skye 'gro'i don mdzad de// rigs rgyud byin rlabs lung bstan rten 'brel bsgrigs// 'phags yul grub chen brgyad cu'i thugs mtsho'i bcud// bod yul 'bri gung sum rtsen 'dod 'jo las// sgrub brgyud me sbyin bu rnams rtsen pa'i skabs// nyer gnyis chos rgyal bstan pa'i chabs 'og der// gsar chos lha min lag pa'i zlos gar gyis// sgrub brgyud khrus mchog tshangs pa'i bu mo ngal// ma 'dod gya gyu ral ba'i mal stan la// lo grangs drug cu skor gcig gzims pa snyam// rang gi bstan la gtsang sbra'i srid zhu mkhan// skyob pa nyid kyis slar yang gangs 'gram 'dir// kun dga'i lang 'tsho gsar pa'i rin chen dpal// skye dgu'i dpal du 'khrungs pa 'di// ya mtshan 'jam dbyangs grags pa tshangs pa'i rigs// ma lus rdo rje'i rigs su mdzad// slar yang rgyal rgyud nyer lnga'i mthar// drag po 'khor lo can gzugs kyis// kla klo'i gdug pa kun bcom nas// sa chen dum bu bcu gnyis por// thub pa'i bstan pa rdzogs ldan du// bsgyur ba ji bzhin 'di na yang*// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi por// sgrub brgyud bstan pa btsugs nas slar// khri thog 'dzin pa bcu gsum dus// rang gi mdzad pa lhag ma'i khur// yongs rdzogs bzhes pa 'di yin no// de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' drin rnams// mos pa'i yul du gsal btab te// phan bde'i chu bo ji snyed pa// gang las 'byung ba'i mtsho chen po// mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po yi// thugs rje nyid du nges gyur pas// ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas// bstan pa'i srog shing 'bri gung pa'i// rnam thar bkra shis sgo mang gi// dkar chag rgyas pa 'dir brjod bya// zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/

gang brtsam par bya ba'i don/ rje nyid kyi bka' yis gnang ba thob cing*/ dgongs pa zab mo rim can du blangs te/ thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas myur du bri bar bya'o// rgyu mtshan des na rje btsun nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yang yin zhing*/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' yang mang du bzhugs pas/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang*/ rtsom pa mthar phyin nas/ dgos don lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs shig thog mar ni phun sum tshogs pa lnga yi sgo nas gleng bslangs te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i che ba'i rnam thar phyogs tsam brjod pa dang 'brel ba/ sgo mang spyi'i dkar chag gi tshogs bstan to// 'di la dgos pa ni dkar chag snga ma rnams su gsal po rang du ma thon pa'i che ba rnams 'dir bkod pas/ gdul bya phyogs ris med pa'i dad pa'i sa bon dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngor/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi dgongs pa gcig pas/ sems can rnams la rang rang gi skal pa dang 'tsham par yul dus 'dir bde skyid stsol zhing ston pa por byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon 'bri gung pa zhes 'dzam gling kun tu nyi ma ltar grags pa gang de'i sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bcas pa brgyud pa la brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar ba'i tshul gyis/ bka' bcas pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba/ lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu/ dgos 'dod kun stsol rin chen dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ gshis sam babs kyis 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen du gnas pa de/ 'gran gyis do zla med pa'i phyag len du legs par bstsal ba ltar/ 'gro ba lha mi'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa de'i tshe/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid la/ mos gus gting nas skyes pa'i dga' ba chen po'i spro ba chen po/ dper na/ dbul pos rang khyim sa 'og na gter bzang po yod pa'i skad cha snyan po thos pa lta bu skyes la/

de nas don du gnyer ba'i 'dod pa'i 'dun pa/ dper na 'bras bu'i shing bzang po'i rtsa ba tshugs te/ yal ga dang lo ma dang 'bras bu rim gyis 'byung bar yid ches pa lta bu thob cing*/ de las kyang rjes su yi rang ba'i bsod nams chen po phan yon brjod kyis mi lang ba mngon du byed pa'o// 'dis mtshon par nus pa'i nying dgos/ dam pa'i chos kyi nying khur gyur pa ni/ gnas lugs gzhi'i phyag rgya chen po rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i kun gzhi/ bde gshegs snying po de nyid khams gsum 'gro ba mtha' dag gi rgyud la rgyun chags par ye gdod ma nas gshis sam babs kyi gnas pa de/ ji ltar yod pa de ltar shes shing go bar byed pa'i rtags dang*/ mtshon par byed pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ gsal bar byed pa'i rnam pa dang*/ myong bar byed pa'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo ba skye ba dang*/ thar pa'i bde ba la dga' spro sogs snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ 'di yang gter gyi kha byang sogs kyi dper na/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs so// smras pa/ gsang chen phyag rgya chen po rang gi sems// gsang gtam tshul gyi mtshan nyid kyi theg par// gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang gis ni// gsang gsum las byung dbang bskur bkar btags so// dkon mchog bkra shis sgo mang sku bzhi'i dngos// mgon med 'gro kun rgyud la yod ces pa'i// mgon skyabs kha byang shing rta'i srol chen po// mgon po 'bri gung pa nyid gzhan las mchog /ces so// gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ chos ston pa'i thog mar/ gdul bya ches dbang po'i ngor e waṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge'i phyag rgya bkas rtags shing*/ byin gyis brlabs pa ltar/ skyob pa nyid kyi dgongs pa'ang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lngar gnas par bzhed pas/ skabs 'dir sbyor ba yang rigs shing 'thad la 'os pas bshad par bya ba 'di lta ste/

ston pa dang*/ 'khor dang*/ dus dang*/ gnas dang*/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rnams so// de la ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rten mchog ngo mtshar can 'di/ bskrun par mdzad pa'i ston pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku/ mi yi gzugs can du byon pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyis/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa dang*/ ye shes kyi gzigs ngo dang mthun par/ thog mar sngon med kyi shing rta'i srol gtod/ sku'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdung rabs dang*/ gsung gi gnang ba thob pa'i slob ma'i mchog rim par byon pa rnams kyis bar skabs su dar shing rgyas par mdzad/ thugs kyi sprul par bstan zhing*/ dri ma med pa'i gdung rgyud du slar yang 'khrungs pa/ kun dga'i mtshan can nyid kyis bka' srol mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gtsug rgyan gyi nor bu ltar mngon par mtho zhing dgos 'dod stsol ba'i rin chen dbang gi rgyal po khyad par 'byed chos dang ldan pa 'dis bdag po'i rkyen mdzad pa'o// 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dbon sras sgom pa/ sgom pa byang chub sogs dang tshul mtshungs pa dus 'dir yang*/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po nyid kyis nges par byin gyis brlabs pa'i yid ches kyi yon tan gyis phyug pa/ dbon po mgon po rgyal mtshan sku 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs thugs kyi sras dam pa rnams yin no// de bzhin du sprul pa'i bzo bo yang*/ sngon gyi ma ṇi bha dra dang tshul mtshungs pa dang bi shwa karmas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam thar can shar phyogs byar yul gyi dbon mo che/ sprul sku rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'khor dang bcas pa'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor ni/ sngon gyi dus su rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyis/ skyob pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs pa ltar dus 'dir yang mgon po lcam dral/

las mkhan/ a phyi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams te/ gtso 'khor thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa 'di rnams kyis/ sku che ba'i yon tan grags pa dang*/ ma grags pa rnams 'og nas zhib par 'chad do// dus phun sum tshogs pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa/ lo lnga brgya pa phrag bcur gnas par gsungs pa de'i lugs kyi 'bras bu'i lnga brgya phrag gsum thal nas/ sgrub pa'i lnga brgya gsum gyi thog ma/ lhag mthong gi dus su ni/ skyob pa nyid kyis srol phye ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir yang*/ sgrub pa'i lnga brgya tha ma/ tshul khrims bslab pa'i dus yin par brtsi dgos te/ bstan rtsis la bzhed pa 'ga' yod na'ang*/ skyob pa'i bzhed pa dus 'khor dang mthun zhing*/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi/ ston pas rtsa rgyud gsungs nas/ deng sang gi bar lo nyis stong bzhi brgya tsam song ste/ chos rgyal rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa bzhis lo brgya phrag re rer chos bstan zin pa las so// 'di ni phyi'i dus grags tshod ltar yin la/ nang dang gsang ba'i dus ni 'chad par 'gyur ro// gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi lung bstan zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod/ sangs rgyas stong gi chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas/ yul wā rā ṇa sī dang chos mtshungs pa'o// chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/ don gyi gtso bo/ rten mchog ngo mtshar can lha mi thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa/ sngon 'jig rten gyi khams su gzhan sus kyang mdzad pa ma mthong ma thos ma grags ste/ rgyu lha mi'i rin po che las grub cing*/ bkod pa phyi mchod rten/ chos sku spros bral gyi rnam pa la/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas steng tog gi bar/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba rgyan gyi rnam pa ma lus pas spras pa/ bum pa'i zhabs bang rim drug sgo mang gis mdzes pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa ste/ sprul sku shākya thub pa bltams dus ser skya'i grong khyer du bsgrubs pa'i bkra shis 'byung ba dang chos mtshungs pa'o// 'di la bzhugs pa'i lha sku'i tshogs ni/

sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la grags pa'i mdo sngags kyi sku'i rigs ma lus par tshang ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam pa mtshon pa ste/ mtshan nyid dang rnam pa kun ldan 'di yang rgyu rin po che las rang grub ye shes kyi rang gzugs lta bur byon pa ni lhan cig skyes pa ngo bo nyid sku ste/ 'di lta bu lha mi gzhan sus kyang mdzad ma nus la skyob pa 'di nyid kyi bka' srol khyad par can du byon pas na/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ngo mtshar can zhes grub pa'o// 'o na rgyal ba sras bcas gzhan sus kyang ma mdzad par/ brgyud pa'i srol 'di ba la bka' bab tu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci snyam na/ de ni gleng bslang pa de nyid kyis lan btab pa'i sgo nas/ mgon po 'bri gung pa che ba'i yon tan phyogs tsam brjod par bya ste/ 'di la thog mar log rtog ngan pa bsal ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu che ba'i khyad par yid ches pa'i tshad ma dang sbyar dgos pas/ skyo ma snga btsan gyi ngan rtog spang bar bya ba 'di lta ste/ 'di na la la dag dwags po bka' brgyud la grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro chos drug dang*/ sa lam gyi rim pa dang*/ bde mchog gi gnas chen sogs la yid brtan mi rung ste/ sa paṇa la sogs pa'i mkhas pas dgag pa mdzad pa dang*/ thos pa med pa'i ku sā li ba dag gi 'dod pas mchog tu bzung ba tsam yin no snyam du sems shing*/ tshig gi lam nas bag med par 'dzer to// de ltar bsam blor shar zhing ngag tu smra ba de dag ni/ dam pa ma yin pa'i bla mas zin cing*/ log pa'i g.yang sa chen por zhugs pas/ theg chen chos spang pa'i nyes pa/ sems can dmyal ba chen po yang ltung ba/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i dmyal ba'i le'u dang*/ sor 'phreng gi mdo dang*/ myang 'das dang*/ dpal phreng gi mdo sogs dang*/ rgyud bla dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs gnyis pa sogs nas gsung ba'i nyes dmigs chen po de lta bu yod pas/

theg chen brgyud pa'i bka' srol 'di la spyir yang*/ ku re dang*/ bzhad gad dang*/ rjes bzlos tsam gyis kyang skur ba 'debs mi rung la/ khyad par rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa rang phyogs 'dzin mkhan dang*/ gzhan phyogs pa gnyis kas ma go bas/ 'khrul gzhi langs shing nyes pa'i tshogs mched pa yin pas/ de spang ba'i phyir phyogs tsam bshad par bya ste/ sdom gsum rab dbye nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dpyad gzhi mdzad pa de/ gang zag gi skyon la sbyor gyi chos kyi skyon la sbyor rgyu min/ yin na sa paṇa rang gis rgya nag ri bo rtser lngar gsungs pa'i rtogs ldan rgyan pa'i dris lan/ phyag rgya chen po'i mig thur na bzhugs pa de dang 'gal ba 'dug gam nges par gzigs dgos/ nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan na/ phyag rgya ba spyi spom la zur za mdzad pa 'dra ba ni/ thabs zab mi zab dang sbyar nas/ mdo rgyud so sor 'byed dgos rgyu yin pa la/ spyi spom des mdo rgyud kyi dbye ba mi phyed ces/ tha snyad tshig tsam la skyon du bzung ba yin/ sgom pa yid byed dang bral ba rgya nag ha shang gi lugs yin zhes/ sa paṇa gyi dgongs par 'chad pa ni/ sa paṇa rmi lam du yang mi rung bar dgongs pa la/ gzhan gyi rgyab rten 'di la kha g.yar nas/ deng sang gi sgom chen phal cher 'khrul la/ lam 'bras pa ma 'khrul/ gsung lo skad mdzad pa 'di'i gting gtan ma go bar/ thos bsam sngon song gi mkhas rlom phar cher/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa ha shang gi sgom zhes rlung ltar du sgrog pa ni/ bdud kyis kha phye ba ste/ nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan nyid na/ gol sa rnams bshad pa'i rjes la/ gang la yang mi gnas par bya/ mi gnas pas mtshan ma mi skye sogs dang*/ dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pas sangs rgyas rjes dran du/ ming btags pa yin zhes gsungs pas/ sa paṇa la brtsi na gsung de kas 'grub pa yod/ lar lam 'bras pa rnams kyang*/ lam 'bras lta ba'i la dor dang*/

brjod bral gyi sgom la thugs rtog chug la/ thugs gzu bor gnas pas/ gtam drang por gsungs/ lam skor gyi mchod rten drung thob dang*/ phyag rgya chen po na ji ltar 'dug yang nā ro chos drug ces bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// ces pa'i tshig 'di ma go bar deng sang*/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi nā ro chos drug tshad ldan min pa'i go ba byed pa ni/ shin tu yang nor tshabs ches pa yin te/ gzhung de'i go ba ni/ rje btsun mi la yan chad la nā ro chos drug las lhag pa'i gsang sngags kyi khrid yongs rdzogs zhal gsal med pas/ khyed nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin yin pas/ de la gtso bor mdzad par rigs/ zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ nā ro phyin la de med zer rgyu yin na/ nā ro chos drug lugs gsum thos dang dngos su 'gal/ gzhan yang sa skya pa nā ro'i chos drug la thugs zhen che bas/ gzhung gi go ba phyin ci log de 'dra mi gsungs bar zhu/ yang gangs can dang*/ ti se gnyis mi gcig gsungs pa la 'khrul nas/ da lta'i gangs ti se 'di gangs ti se min zhes gsungs par/ rang gzhan gnyis kas nor ba mang bas/ sa paṇa gyi bzhed pa la/ da lta snga ris stod kyi gangs ti se 'di gangs ti se nyid yin te/ gnas gtan yan lag 'byung 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ chos skyong gi bstod par yang*/ khyod bzhugs ti se'i gangs ri la// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ bde mchog gi gnas chen du gsungs pa dang sbyor ba'i dgongs pa'o// gzhan yang deng sang sgom byed pa'i dus min pa'i grub mtha' 'cha' bar mdzad nas/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ ma bsgoms pa'i kha bshad kyi nyes dmigs shin tu mang bar gsungs pa de rnams dang*/ shan+ti pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ro ma myong par/ thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab la chags bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig ces gsungs pa de ji ltar drang*/ sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring sdus gsum ka las/

ma 'ongs pa'i dge slong lug ltar lkugs pa'i rang bzhin shes rab 'chal ba dag lus ma bsgoms/ sems ma bsgoms par/ 'di ltar gzugs 'jig pa ni/ gzugs mi rtag pa'o zhes/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ston par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa de la'ang thugs rtog chug cig /yang thos pa'i rjes la bsgom dgos kyi/ deng sang mtshan nyid ma bslabs par sgom byed pa/ lag rdum brag la 'dzeg pa dang 'dra bsam du blo la 'char zhing smra mod/ rang re tsho'i deng sang gi slob gnyer byed lugs 'di/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i thos pa'i don du ci ltar 'gro legs par gzigs shig gzhung lugs brgya phrag 'dzin pa dang*/ don slob pa dang*/ lta ngan rigs pas sun 'byin pa rnams deng sang ci ltar yod lags sam/ rang re tsho'i rigs pa kho nar tshig nor sgug pa 'di la ni/ mu stegs kyi rtog ge mkhan po'i skyon du blta/ bsdus pa rtsa ba'i ming dang*/ bde mi bde sogs ni rgya gar mkhas pa'i chos la med/ thal skad 'am gcig zer ba'i ku co 'don pa ni/ sa paṇa yan chod ma byung ngo*// yang tshul khrims la gces par dgos pa bstan pa'i rtsa ba rang yin mod/ deng sang tshul chos tsam gtso bor byed pa'i bslab bya 'di yang*/ 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i phyir bcos gal che ba rnams dang 'dod chung chog shes/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gang du yang mi brtsi ba'i gnad chung la thugs rtsol chen po mdzad pa 'di rtsa ba bor nas/ yal ga la 'ju ba bdud las su gsungs pa dang 'dra ba ma yin nam thugs gzu bos chod cig de ltar thos bsam pa dang*/ nyams len pa su yin yang*/ mi rigs pa'i gzugs la'ang mi rigs na// the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos// de phyir btang snyoms bzhag la nyes pa med// ces gsungs pa ltar 'dir bkod kyis/ gang zag dang chos la sdang shugs ni bstan nas med kyi/ 'on kyang dwags po bka' brgyud kyi che 'don la/ thog mar log rtog spang phyir smras pa'o// da ni brgyud pa'i bka' bab 'di nyid kyi che ba'i rnam par thar pa skabs su bab pa phyogs tsam zhig

/gcam bu'i tshul ma yin pa'i gnas tshul brjod par bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i gsung las kyang*/ spyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' bab bod yul phebs pa'i srol/ tshad ldan ji snyed pa 'di dag gi nang nas/ mnga' bdag mar pa nas brgyud pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi srol chen po 'di ni gangs can bstan pa'i snying po rtsod bral yin zhes gsungs la/ lhag par dge slong 'tsho byed lung bstan brnyes pa sogs kyi rnam thar dang*/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po nyid/ siṅga gling gi dgra bcom dang paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lo rgyus la brten nas/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi thugs kyi sprul pa yin tshul rnams yang yang gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang skyob pa nyid dang*/ thugs rgyud gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan yid ches pa 'ga' zhig bdag nyid rang la yod pas/ de rnams gzhir bzhag tu byas la/ tshig gi zur phyin pa'i go rim ni 'di lta ste/ mdo sde snying rje chen po pad dkar las/ mnga' bdag khri ral lung bstan pa'i rjes su/ byang phyogs su dge slong 'tsho byed ces pa theg chen pa zhig 'byung ste/ des sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten chen po zhig pa 'chos shing*/ gser gyis brgyan pa la sogs pa byed cing bde ba can du skye'o// byang phyogs kyi rgyud na grong shing kun skye ba zhes bya bar/ tshems mche ba la mchod pa rgya chen po byed cing*/ dge slong khrims ldan mang du 'byung ste/ thams cad theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan las 'da' ste/ de rnams kyis nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byed par 'gyur gyi mya ngan ma byed ces gsungs pa 'dis ni/ dwags po bka' brgyud rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bor lung bstan pa yin te/ bu ston bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gis kyang 'di ltar du bshad do// lung snga ma sgam po pa dang phyi ma 'bri gung pa'i lung bstan du nges la/ yang rnga bo che'i mdo dang*/

sprin chen po'i mdo dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang*/ mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rnams su mgon po klu sgrub lung bstan la/ khyad par du/ rnga bo che dang*/ sprin chen las/ li tsa byi gzhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba 'di klu sgrub tu gyur nas/ nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byed tshul dang*/ yang de grong khyer dmag gis mi tshugs par nga'i ming 'chang ba'i dge slong 'gyur zhes sogs dang*/ bstan pa lo brgyad cu par gyur pa'i tshe na dge slong blo 'chang zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ chos kyi sku rtag brtan ther zug pa'i tshul zab mo ston/ zhes sogs rgyas par mdo sde de dag nyid du gzigs pas mkhyen pa ltar/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam thar bzang po 'di rnams lung bstan par shes par bya ste/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi sprul pa rgyal sras li tsa byi dang*/ de'i sprul pa slob dpon klu sgrub yin pa ni/ bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyis mthun grub yin la/ 'jig rten mgon po 'di pa/ klu sgrub kyi thugs kyi sprul pa yin pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du 'byon pa'i dus siṅga gling gi dgra bcom pas me tog gsum mi rnying par byin gyis brlabs nas bskur te/ gcig klu sgrub kyi skye bar gtod cig gsungs pa las/ phyis bod du phebs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i lung bstan las/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po klu sgrub kyi skye ba yin pa'i nges shes rnyed nas/ me tog phul zhing*/ paṇa chen dang skyob pa gnyis mchid kyi yi ge skyes bskur lan mdzad tshul rtsod med du grags pas so// gzhan yang 'di la yid ches rgyal ba'i lung du gyur pa ni/ rnga bo che'i mdo dang myang 'das dang*/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo sogs snying po nges don gyi bka' rnams la/ dgongs gcig gi grub mtha' rnams lung bstan pa dang*/

de yang bstan pa lo brgyad cu pa'i dus yin par gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ deng sang drug bcu kha ral du ma sleb/ brgyad cu pa'i dus yin gsungs pa dang*/ rang 'grig tu byung ba dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ston pa'i gsung rab sa steng du// dus mtha' 'jig rten rnam pa ni// sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni// 'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ sdom brtson dang*/ rgyal po mang ba zhig lung bstan pa'i mthar// sdom brtson thams cad bsgrags pa yang*// ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa// ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong*// byed par 'gyur ba the tshom med// thams cad byang chub lung bstan te// nga yi byang chub mchog thob 'gyur// de bzhin 'jig rten sbyin gnas 'gyur// srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed// sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson pas// grags pa 'dzin pa'i shes par bya// zhes pa'i mdo rgyud 'di rnams kyis ni/ rigs rgyud rgyal po'i lugs ltar 'byon tshul dang*/ rten mchod ngo mtshar can bzhengs tshul dang*// gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams su lung bstan 'dug pa phyogs lhung sangs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis gzigs pas rig pa'o// gzhan yang rgya gar grub chen nā ro pa sogs dang*/ bod kyi mnga' bdag mar pa sogs kyi lung bstan tshul mang mod/ yi ge mang dogs ma bkod la/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' la mi brtsi ba mi yong ba'i lugs yin pas de nyid zur tsam bkod pa'o// yang rgyal ba'i rnam sprul bod la bka' drin che ba/ u rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ni/ shin tu yang gsal bar lung bstan te/ tshig rigs rnams mang dogs pas/ snying por bkod na// lung bstan shel gyi me long*/ sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas/ rtse chen brag nas bton pa'i shog ser ma las 'di rnams byung ste/ byang phyogs 'bri gung mthil zhes grags pa na: grub pa thob pa lnga nas brgyud pa'i mthar:

gcung zhes grags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste: sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: gdul bya'i zhing ni khri phrag mang po skyong : de nas bde ba can du dbugs dbyung zhing : slar yang gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong du 'byon: sa phyogs de yi gtsug gi nor bu ru: dharma'i mtshan can lha las babs pa'i sras: byang chub sems dpa' gang shar 'dzin med skyong : tshul 'chos bral zhing cho rol spyod pa che: sgom chen srog 'dzin sbyin shugs gtong la dga': che ba'i rtags brgyad ya mtshan sku la rdzogs: sde brgyad zil gnon spyan mig gar stabs lta: zhes sogs/ rje 'di nyid dngos su gsal la/ gzhan yang 'brel tshad don ldan yin tshul/ 'phrin las rgyas tshul/ lha bab kyi gdung rgyud yin tshul zhib pa'i 'og tu gzhan yang*/ 'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs na: pad+ma nga dang smon lam 'brel ba'i rigs: las can skyes bu thar thor 'byung bar 'gyur: de rnams cha lugs spyod pa ma nges te: bla ma slob dpon bshes gnyen sgom chen dang : gnas brtan mi dpon khrims bdag tshul 'dzin cing : dad mos yi dam gtor chos dag la byed: sngags 'chang tshul shes stobs dang ldan pa 'byung : sku gdung rin chen bkra shis sgo mang ni: gsum 'byung gling la zhig ral gcig kyang 'byung : zhig gsos sgo mang bdun 'byung slar yang ni: de yi srung thabs ti sgro'i brag la yod: de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i zhing khams de: bod khams byang rigs rnams su phal cher smin: stobs dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des: dus mtha'i 'gro ba dpag med 'dren par 'gyur: de ltar byang phyogs 'bri gung se ba'i gling : khyad par can gyi gnas su bstan pa ni: pad 'byung bdag gis zho stod ti sgro ru: yang dag don gyi mar me dgu pa yi: dkyil 'khor zhal phye lha srin btul ba'i tshe: zhes sogs chos srung dam la btags tshul gsungs nas/ de phyir sa yis phyogs der bzhugs pa yis:

dge sbyong rigs gyur sems pa'i rang bzhin te: lhun grub bab kyi rgyal ba'i gnas lung bstan: der skyes 'gro ba 'khor ba mtha' yod yin: sgrub la brtson rnams sa lam myur bgrod cing : myur du theg chen thob par ngas lung bstan: zhes gsungs pas/ khyad par u rgyan gu ru la tshad mar brtsi ba tsho ni/ 'di ka rang gis kyang yid ches te/ gnas dang bsgrub pa po dang*/ rten mchog ngo mtshar can dang*/ lhag par bla ma rin po che sku 'khor bcas la mos gus khyad par can bskyed par rigs so// de ltar skyob pa rin po che de nyid/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa yin pas/ sngon shākya'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa dang cha mthun du bstan pa'i tshul/ dkar chag gong ma dag las kyang gsal mod/ mdor bsdu na/ shar 'bri klung chos kyi zhing khams su sku bltams/ lho zla sngon dpal ri klung mo cher dka' ba spyad nas/ 'jig rten pa'i snyoms 'jug brgyad thob/ dbus ngam shod dpal gyi phag mo grur ji lta ji snyed kyi chos rnams sangs rgyas shing byang chub/ nub e chung rdo rje'i brag phug tu slar yang bdud 'dul ba'i tshul bstan/ byang dri za'i grong khyer zhabs kyis bcags nas lha mi'i bsnyen bkur bzhes pa'i 'phrin las la mnga' brnyes la/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa de'i tshe/ bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten mchog sngon chad rgya bod du ma grags pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can dang ldan pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs mtshon nus pa zhig ji ltar du bsgrub par bya snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe/ sngon sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus thugs nyams su 'khrungs pa'i de nyid thugs kyi dran pas gsal thebs te/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi zhabs tog tu yang thog mar dgongs pa gnang la phyis ni/ rje btsun byams pa'i 'khor 'dus pa 'dra ba'i bu slob kyi tshogs dang mnyam pa'i 'bri gung nyid du 'du ba la sogs pa/

'phrin las ches rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gnas 'di nyid du 'grigs nas/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas brtsams te bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi sku'i rgyal tshab lta bur yang dgongs te/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ mos gus kyi nyi ma shar na/ byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du/ sngon chad 'jig rten na 'di lta bu'i dpe med pa la/ thugs dam zhal gzigs mnyam nyid dper bkod nas/ sku bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa la/ 'og gzhi nas tog gi bar rgyu rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa ni ngo bo nyid sku/ phyi'i dbyibs bkod bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ sku gdung cha brgyad mchod rten/ dpal reg pa med pa du ba lta bu/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs/ go ma sa la gan+dha sogs dang cha 'dra yang*/ gtso bor bkra shis 'byung ba dang sbyar ba chos kyi sku pho brang rten dkyil 'khor gcig gi nang du mdo sngags kyi lha tshogs bla ma brgyud pa'i gtso bo dang bcas pa bzhugs pa ni longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam pa rgyan cha lugs mtshan nyid sna tshogs pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku ste spyi dgos kyi nang bzhugs rab gnas dang bcas pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi tshad ma bzhis gtan la phab pa ni/ chos phun sum tshogs pa'o// dkar chag dngos grub char 'bebs las/ sgo mang spyi'i tshoms te le'u dang po// ༈ //byin rlabs can gyi rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas// 'phrin las sgrub mdzad chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba btab nas le'u gnyis pa bri// da ni skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i sku gdung rabs dri ma med par 'khrungs shing*/ gsung chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' bsgyur te/ thugs rje'i mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi lhag ma 'phro can ma lus pa spel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i ched du/ bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa kun dga' rin chen zhabs 'di skyob pa nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yin pa ni/

zab chos gser khang sgo bcad ma las/ mi rabs bcu gsum pa la gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong du 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ shing 'di sta yu ste'u yu nyan dus yong gsungs pa dang 'grig la/ ba ra bong phyugs 'byung dus yong gsungs pa sogs dang yang 'grig pa'i yid ches yod/ u rgyan gyis sngar gyi lung bstan dang*/ zhang tshan 'khrugs pas dbus gtsang sil bur gtong : mi mthun sde la gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung : snang mdzad mi g.yo rab tu brtan par gnas: de ni 'bri gung spyan snga bcu gsum pa: zhes 'byung la/ pad+ma gling pas kyang gu ru'i sprul par gsungs pa ltar du/ u rgyan pad+mas lung bstan zhing skyob pa nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gdul bya dag pa'i snang ngor/ sku gsung thugs mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi rnam thar rmad du byung bas/ skyob pa nyid kyi thugs kyi sprul par gdon mi za ba'i bdag nyid rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas thugs kyi dgongs pa sngon slob pa'i dus kyi gleng gzhi dang mthun par/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ zas gtsang gi sras shākya thub pa'i sku'i rnam par bstan pa de nyid nas brtsams te/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams dang*/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ 'gro mgon rin po che/ skyob pa nyid nas brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dbyer med cing*/ de dag nyid las mi gzhan la/ so so ma yin pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha jo bo dkon mchog gsum/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgo khyud rtsig pa/ pañtsa ra ga bang rim du brtsegs par bum pa bzang po/ bre dang gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum char khebs dang tog gis spras pa/ ri dwags dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ dar dpyangs chen po 'phan ring gis legs par brgyan pa/

rigs kyi phyag mtshan tha dad pa rnam par phye ba/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bzhugs pa'i bang rim/ rgyud sde dang mdo'i rim pa ltar gsal ba/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po 'phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i rten mchog ngo mtshar can/ sngar gyi bka' srol bzang po de nyid thugs kyi dran sos pa lta bus bzhed pa la rag pa de'i tshe/ rin po che nyid cho 'phrul gsum gyi sgo nas/ srid gsum dbang du bsdus shing nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i thugs rje'i shugs las grub pa'i bu slob kyi tshogs dang dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho theg pa che chung gi brtul zhugs dang spyod lam sna tshogs/ rigs ma nges pa rnams kyi dad pa dang 'dun pa/ 'bad pa dang rtsol ba/ rgyu tshogs dang cha rkyen gyi gzhi bzung*/ dpon chen po mgon rgyal gyis thog mtha' bar du dge ba mthar phyin pa'i bdag mdzad/ 'di ni sngon gyi dbon chen po tshul rin dang chos mtshungs te/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' srung gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'am/ shākya seng ge'i nye gnas kun dga' bo'i rnam par thar pa can/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa por smon lam thebs shing*/ byin gyis brlabs pas/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin rdzu 'phrul lta bu'i tshul gyis mdzad pa la rngo thogs pa ni/ da lta kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'di nyid kyis chog la/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du/ che ba'i yon tan cha tsam ni 'og nas kyang 'chad par 'gyur ro// rin po che'i thugs rje las grub pa'i rig byed pa ni/ sprul pa'i bzo bor grags shing*/ phyag gi 'phrul rtsed gzhan sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa'i myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul gyi phyag rjes su/ spyi dang khyad par gyi phyag tshad thig rtsa rnams dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/

slob dpon dpal gyis sde'i grub thob brgyad cu'i bri thabs la sogs pa/ gsung rab mang po'i don dgongs shing*/ legs pa'i cha btu ba la mkhas pa/ mdor na bi shwa karmas nges par byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bka' bab 'di pa'i phrin las bsgrub par yang smon lam thebs pa/ sngon gyi ma ṇi bha dra nor bu bzang po dang tshul mtshungs pa/ byar gyi sprul sku rdo rje rgyal mtshan badz+ra dh+wa dza zhes bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang gang la ci mkho'i rig byed phul phyin sprul sku du ba la sogs pa/ gzhan yang las thabs gang la spyi 'os kyi do dam zhabs 'jug pa rnams so so nas thugs kyi sras su gyur pa'i bla ma slob dpon rnams dang*/ sku'i nye gnas che ba dang*/ gnyen pa rnams kyi gtso mdzad nas/ 'khor rnams bzhi/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs ldan rnams kyis rang rang gi skal pa las gang 'byor bsgrub par nus pa'i rdzas dang*/ yo byad zhabs 'bring du 'gyur ba dang bcas te/ lo khyud bskor bzhi'i nang du legs par grub pa'i thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang*/ snga ma dag las kyang khyad chos lhag gi phyug pa/ spyir gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gang 'dod 'phral du ster ba las/ bye brag tu skyob pa nyid kyi gsung las/ rten mchog 'di la gsol ba btab na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las 'grub/ dge sbyor bzang po 'phral du skye/ rjes la mthil 'dir dge 'dun tshogs che ba/ rdzas dang yo byad chos kyi 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par rgyas shing*/ bla ma tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin zhes/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gsung de tshad mar byas pa/ dgos 'dod kun rtsol rin chen dbang gi rgyal po'i dkar chag brjod par bya'o// zhes pa ni/ dang po don tsam ston pa'o// las su bya ba gang brjod na/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis/ rgyu dang*/ bkod pa/ lha grangs/ nang gzhug rnams re re bzhin phun sum tshogs tshul/ so so'i dus skabs ji ltar rigs pa ni/

ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma dang*/ dpag par dka' ba'i cho 'phrul dang*/ dge zhing shis pa'i rten 'brel rnams/ yongs su rdzogs pa brjod kyis mi lang na'ang*/ phyogs tsam mtshon pa dang bcas te'o// byed pa po gang gis brjod na/ mi shes pa dang*/ gya tshom dang*/ rang dga' dang*/ rnam par rtog pas snyan ngag tu bsgrags pa lta bus brjod pa ni ma yin gyi/ bstan pa spyi dang khyad par can la chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa yod cing*/ spyi dang khyad par gyi mang du thos pa dang ldan pa'i steng du/ bla ma rin po che'i bka' yi gnang ba thob cing*/ 'phrin las sgrub pa'i kha lo bsgyur ba rnams kyis yang dang yang du bskul bar mdzad de/ dpon slob dgongs pa gcig tu gyur pa'i tshogs pas so// dgos pa ci'i phyir brjod na/ da lta'i gdul bya rnams/ rten 'di'i phyogs su dge ba'i rtsa ba che chung gang 'dres de thams cad la gzengs bstod cing yi rangs la/ zad mi shes pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba bsngo bas thebs pa dang*/ bla ma brgyud srol gyi rnam thar la nges shes 'drongs nas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa rnyed pa sogs/ dge legs rgya mtsho chen po 'phel ba'i dgos pa/ bshad kyis mi lang ba rnams 'grub pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams la yang*/ bka' srol bzang po'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa'i dgos pa can gyis yang phyir du'o// rgyu mtshan gang las brjod snyam na/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs sems can la 'jug pa ni/ mos gus skyes pa/ gsol ba thebs pa/ rten 'brel 'grig pa rnams/ rten 'brel gyi mnga' bdag brgyud srol 'di pa'i phyag len bzang po da lta mngon du gyur pa 'di nyid kyi che ba las so// de ltar brjod pa de gang gi lugs dang*/ su'i bzhed par brjod snyam na chos thams cad la tshad mar gyur cing*/ gang zag thams cad la dbang du gyur pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na yin na sangs rgyas dgyes na/

sangs rgyas kyi lugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bzhed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i thabs su gyur pa'o// de ltar bla ma rin po che'i dgongs pa nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i thabs kyi bar du brjod pa'i don rnams/ rten mchog ngo mtshar can 'di nyid la yod cing gnas te bzhugs la/ tshig rnams brda 'phrod pa ni/ dkar chag 'di yongs rdzogs sam/ le'u 'di nyid la yang yod pa'o// de ltar legs par sbyar ba saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la grags pa'i rnam par dbye ba bdun du bkod pa las/ da ni de rnams khongs rgyal du gnas pa'i tshul gyis zhib tu brjod par bya ste/ de la rten mchog 'di ni/ sngon skyob pa nyid kyi thugs dam gzigs nyams la 'khrungs pa yin te/ sngon shar dwags la sgam por phebs/ sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus skabs zhig na/ sgam po gdar gyi ri la phebs pa'i tshe/ lho phyogs tsā ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i dag pa shel gyi ri bo de mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang tshad mar yod pa de mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rta rnga'i drwa mig steng du gdan drangs nas/ skyob pa nyid kyi gzigs snang du shin tu gsal bar gtan la phebs pa'i thugs dam nyams rtogs de nyid/ phyis 'gro mgon gyi gdung rten gyi zhabs tog dang sku tshab lta bur rten mchog rgya bod du sngar ma grags pa zhig bzhengs par dgongs pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi thugs dran sos pa lta bu'i tshul gyis/ ting nge 'dzin de mngon du gyur nas/ de nyid la nyams myong tshad mar mdzad cing*/ gzhan tshad ma gsum dang cha mthun ji ltar rigs pa la brten nas bka' srol gtod pa de bzhin du/ thugs sras spyan snga 'bri gung gling par grags pa shes rab 'byung gnas brgyud pa rnams kyis kyang*/ sa phyogs 'di nyid du shing rta'i srol chen po bzung la/ phyis spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa rnams kyis/

gdan sa phag mo grur yang*/ 'di ba'i srol cha mthun du 'dzin nus pa byung zhing*/ phyogs 'dir ni bcu gnyis rin po cher grags pa/ rdo rje rin chen gyis slar yang zhig gsos kyi tshul gyis sgo mang bzhengs par mdzad la/ nyer brgyad par mtshan gsol ba'i rdo rje rgyal po/ rgya gar du mnga' bdag mai tri pa zhes grags/ gtsang du mkhas grub bde legs rgyal mtshan du yang grags pa de nyid kyis sgo mang yang bzhengs la gcung kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ nyer gnyis par mtshan gsol ba de nyid kyis thugs dam bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur dang*/ rten mchog phul du phyin pa'i sgo mang yang bzhengs la/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas/ dus mnyam pa'i mkhas grub thams cad kyang slob mar gyur cing*/ phyis nang rten gyi sgo mang zhig kyang bu slob rnams kyis grub pas/ thog mar dge ba'i srol 'byed skyob pa nyid dang*/ bar du dge ba'i srog shing nyer gnyis rin po che de nyid bka' drin du che la/ tha mar dge ba'i bka' drin can/ bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa'i rin po che ni/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid kho na yin te/ rgyu mtshan rgyas pa ni/ mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes mchog rin chen rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rnam thar chen mo las rtogs dgos la/ 'dir cha tsam brjod pa skabs su bab kyang*/ zhib mor brjod pa ni bdag cag rnams kyis bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa yin pa dang*/ spyir du rin po che nyid slob dpon pad+ma'i lung bstan las byung ba bzhin du/ sku yi tshul 'chos mi mnga' la/ ngo bstod dang*/ che bstod gang yang dang du mi bzhes pa zhig yod kyang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya skal ldan dag la la'ang snang bar bya ba'i phyir du/ rnam par thar pa re re tsam gyi gnang ba zhus nas brjod par bya ste/ nyer gnyis rin po che'i zhabs phyi nas brtsams te/ rin po che 'di pa'i bar/ de dag tu gdung rgyud dri ma med pa'i rnam thar bzang po gser gyi ri bo ltar star la chags par bzhugs na'ang*/

gdul bya'i skal pas bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib sna tshogs kyi dbang las/ sngon bstan pa snga dar dang*/ phyi dar gyi rim pa gnyis las brgyud pa'i 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyi nyams len dang*/ khyad par bod yul 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs gcig pu o rgyan gyi rgyal po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas/ brgyud pa'i lta sgom khyad par can dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po/ mar 'brog 'gos gnyos/ gyi 'bro sogs las brgyud pa'i gsang sngags gyi lag len khyad par can rnams dang*/ sa rngog bu dol sogs kyi bshad rgyun khyad par can dang*/ zhi phyag rdzogs gcod sogs dang 'brel ba'i sgrub tshugs khyad par can te/ sngar gyi lugs srol bzang po de rnams gdul bya 'ga' zhig gi bsod rnams la ma ran pa dang*/ bstan pa nges don yang nor bu ltar dgra mang ba dang*/ gsar byung gi grub mtha' rtog ge'i blo la shar ba 'ga' zhig 'khyog por 'dren pa'i smon lam grub pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa po rang shugs kyi 'dus nas rgyas shing yangs par gyur te/ sa steng 'di phal cher du khyab la/ rang rang so so'i srol 'dzin par sems la rloms shing khas 'che la/ ming 'dzin pa dag kyang*/ don la 'chad rgyu'i snying po grub mtha' yin par smra rgyu ni/ khungs med kyi blos gar te/ nyid las gzhan gyi 'byor pa dkon par gyur pa de'i tshe/ de'i dus ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa 'di sku skye ba bzhes pa ni/ gzhan dang gzhan dag las kyang bka' drin che bar mngon te/ ji ltar bskal ba bzang po 'di chags nas// skye dgu tshe dpal 'byor pas ha cang skyid// de nas mar 'grib sdug bsngal nyen pa'i tshe// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung gi// chos kyi 'byor pas skye dgu ngal sos so// slar yang mar 'grib rtsod dus tshe lo brgya// snyigs ma lnga bdo skye dgu 'phongs pa'i dus// mu stegs grub mtha' btsas nas nyam thag tshe// 'jig rten ngal gsor shākya thub pa byon// de bzhin gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sngon rab chos// bzang po nub nas gsar byung lta spyod kyis// bdag cag skal ba ngan par gyur dus 'dir// skyob pa khyod 'khrungs bka' drin gzhan las che// zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do// dus de'i tshe/

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang*/ brgyud pa dang 'brel ba'i chos dang*/ nges pa'i don gyi lta ba dang*/ 'chug pa med pa'i sgom pa dang*/ bstan pa la phan pa'i spyod pa dang*/ 'phrin las kyi phyag rjes bzang po'i srol chen po gyen du 'degs par mdzad pa de ni/ gnas dus kyi dbang gis phal mo ches bsgrub par mi nus la/ gong gi gdung rgyud dri ma med pa gcig gnyis kyi skabs su rnyed par dka' ba tsam du bstan pa las/ rin po che nyid kyi phyag tu rang bab kyis so so nas 'byor zhing lhun gyis grub par gyur pa ni/ thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyang dgongs pa gcig pas bstan pa gcig rgyal sras bstan 'dzin thams cad kyang grub mtha' gcig pas 'phrin las gcig bka' sdod srung ma thams cad kyang ye shes gcig pas nus mthu gcig par nges pa'o// zhes dgongs pa la shar ba'i tshul bstan nas/ de lta bu'i phan bde'i lam bzang po la gdul bya rnams bkri zhing*/ bstan pa'i me ro rnying pa gso ba lta bu'i dgongs pa sngon du btang ste/ che btsun dmangs dang bcas pa'i skye 'gro lha mi 'khor du dang por bsdus/ bar du smin/ tha mar grol bar mdzad pa'i rim pa yang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi blo yi snang ba la shar bar gyur to// smras pa/ rkang gnyis gtso bo bltams dus nas// nyid rang sangs rgyas yin pa la// sa la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga mchog nyid ces gsungs ci dgos// de tshe gter kha lnga brgya phyed// rgod ma lnga brgya rte'u 'brangs// sa bdag chos rje'i lung bstan bzhes// don grub mtshan gsol mi mtshar ram// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// nyid kyi yul du rang byon nas// 'khor bcas rang nor spyod pa la// bdag cag 'gram chu ci la ldang*// de bas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod kun// khyod kyi phyogs nas bstan 'dzin gyi// mdzad pa thams cad khyod gcig pus// mdzad 'di bdag cag gad mo bro// zlos gar lags so// nyid kyi mkhyen rab thugs rjes mdzad pa'i snyan grags kyi dri bzhon de nyin byed gzhon nu'i zer dang 'grogs nas sa steng thams cad du khyab par gyur pa de'i tshe/

ti se dang*/ la phyi/ tsā ri tra ste gnas chen po gsum dang*/ gzhan yang pūl+li ra ma/ dzā lan+dha ra la sogs pa'i yul nyer bzhi'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rgya gar dang*/ rgya nag mnga' ris/ mdo khams/ dwags kong*/ dbus gtsang gi khams len sgrub brgyud la dad pa'i bag chags bzang po ji snyed cig yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rab tu byung ba/ skyes pa bud med sogs mtha' yas pa grangs las 'das shing brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams/ zhabs kyi drung du lhags te/ sku'i gzi byin mthong bas tshim pa dang*/ gsung gi gdams ngag thos pas grol ba dang*/ thugs kyi sras su gyur te sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa dang*/ 'phrin las kyi bka' bab pa dang*/ gzhan yang thun mong gi dngos grub nad las grol/ gdon las thar/ dbang thang rgyas pa sogs dang*/ nyi tshe ba'i dngos grub 'dzin blo skyes pa dang*/ dpyod blo rno ba dang*/ sems gnas kyi zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong gi char sgro btags bcu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur pa sogs kyis gdul bya'i re ba skong ba ni/ da lta bdag cag rnams la mngon du gyur pa 'di/ phyi ma'i 'dul bya'i ngor yi ger bris pa cha tsam mo// yang de'i tshe/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor mi snang ba mi ma yin mang pos btud cing bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i rnam thar ni gsang ba'i rnam thar nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ mi'i gtso bo stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ sgar pa don yod rdo rje zhes 'dzam bu gling du grags pa des kyang*/ dregs pa'i gtsug phud rgyan dang bcas pa/ rin po che 'di nyid kyi zhabs kyi gdan du phul te/ bka' bsgrub par dam bcas te/ de'i rten 'brel byed pa'i rang shugs kyis kyang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid go skabs ches yangs par yang gyur to// yang dus de dang nye ba na bram ze rin po che sa ra ha'i thugs las sprul pa'i karma pa brgyud pa bdun par byon pa zhwa nag chos grags rgya mtsho dang*/

thugs kyi ye shes gcig yin yang*/ sku yi snang ba gdul bya'i snang ngor so sor bzhes pa'i rin po che 'di nyid gdan 'dzom zhing bka' bgro bar mdzad pa las kyang tshul snga ma ltar gyur to// de bzhin du zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa sprul sku nyid dang*/ thugs kyi ye shes gcig pa sogs rten 'brel gyi tshogs snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs so// gzhan yang brgyud pa 'di paṇa chen shākya shrī dang skyob pa'i dus nyid nas thugs rgyud ye shes gcig pa la bka' srol so sor 'dzin pa lta bu'i phyag bzhes kyis/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'degs pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun yod pa ltar rin po che 'di nyid kyis kyang phyag bzhes nyid du mdzad de/ lo re 'jog lta bur jo gdan chos lung tshogs pa rnams/ zhabs drung lhags nas/ dbyar gnas pa sogs kyi sgo nas gsung gi bdud rtsis rang rang so so'i rgyud smin grol mdzad cing*/ mkhan chen rim par byon pa lnga tsam la gdan 'dzom pa'i chos kyi bgro ba dang*/ dpon slob tshogs pa'i bka' bkod smon lam rten 'brel bzang pos kyang bstan pa'i bya ba rgyas par mdzad do// gzhan yang*/ 'bri se ba byang chub kyi gling nyid ma gha dha rdo rje'i gdan nyid du slar yang byin gyis brlabs nas/ dus rtag tu nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa'i sgrub sde rgya chen sngon gyi zhig gsos lta bu'i tshul du bskrun par mdzad pa ni/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyi 'dul bar 'os pa la/ sku'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i rnam thar yin la/ thugs dam du bka' 'gyur ro cog dang*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gis glegs bam yongs su rdzogs pa rgyu rin po che las grub par mdzad pa ni/ gsung kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul du mngon/ mtshe'u kha bde mchog gi pho brang chen por dus rtag tu bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang nas/

'jig rten kun la lan drug la sogs par gzigs te/ 'dul bar 'os pa dag dus las mi yol zhing*/ bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i sgo nas mngon par mkhyen pas/ phal pa la lkog tu gyur pa'i don mang po yang mngon du gyur nas lung du ston pa dang*/ seng ge'i khri'i steng nas/ rigs can so so'i skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dus nam yang bskor ba mdzad pa ni/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul gyi gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'o// de nas mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi cho 'phrul/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya so so'i ngor tha dad du mar byon pa'i gsung rabs rnams/ rgyal ba nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' bsdu ba po rnams kyis/ gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa ltar/ sku'i rten rnams kyi bsdu ba brgyud pa 'di nyid la phrin las kyi bka' bab pa de nyid phyag bzhes su gnang ba'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i ched du/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas lhags pa dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu/ mkhas pa dang grub thob dang*/ slob gnyer ba dang*/ rtogs ldan dang*/ dge slong dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ sgom chen dang*/ nya ma dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma dang*/ lha 'bangs dang*/ gzhan yang mi che ba'i rgyal po dang*/ phyi blon nang blon dang*/ zhabs 'bring ba dang*/ pho nya ba dang*/ dmangs phal mo che rigs sna tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi bya bral dang*/ gnas bskor ba dang*/ rgya gar gyi dzo ki dang*/ bram ze dang*/ kha che dang*/ bal po'i mi rigs dang*/ rgya nag po'i lung gis phyug pa'i tha'i ji dang*/ tshong dpon dang*/ 'gron lam pa la sogs pa/ tha na cang shes pa'i rta mchog dang*/ 'dab chags la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba/ mdor na yan lag brgyad pa'i mtsho la chu bya'i tshogs rnams rgyang ring po nas snyeg pa ji lta ba bzhin du/

rin po che nyid kyi thugs rjes skye ba mang por bskul ba'i gdul bya'i tshogs rnams/ da lta zhing mchog 'di nyid du bgrod du rung tsam gyi sa yul so sor skye ba blangs nas yod pa rnams zhabs kyi drung du skad cig yud tsam thengs re la yang yang du 'dus nas/ sku mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yos shing*/ gsung thos pa tsam gyis mos gus kyi gdung shugs bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa las/ 'bul ba'i bye brag rin po che'i rigs rin thang gzhal du med pa nas brtsams te/ lha dang mi yi longs spyod/ rgya/ hor/ bod/ li/ bal po/ rgya gar sogs kyi rdzas dang*/ zog dang*/ zong du tshong pa'i rigs dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs pa/ rta dang glang po sogs che 'bul chung 'bul tha na khab dang skud pas mtshon pa lta bu brjod kyis mi lang ba phyag tu ji ltar 'dus pa nas/ bstan pa dang sems can 'ba' zhig gi ched du dmigs te/ rang cag dngos dang brgyud pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du 'gyur ba'i thabs kyi sgo gang zab dang*/ rten 'brel gyi legs tshogs gang che zhig bsgrub pa'i dgongs pa las/ gzhan rdzas kyi dngos po rdul phran tsam zhig dus skad cig ma tsam yang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i tshul mi mnga' ba las/ skabs de'i dus kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gzigs snang la shar tshul ni/ sngon gyi skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs dgongs de rnams/ slar yang mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyis gsal thebs par gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ sngar byon gyi rgyal ba ji snyed pas/ rang rang gi gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams rim gyis drang ba'i phyir du/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs te byin gyis brlabs pa sha stag tu byung*/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di'i bstan pa nyid la yang*/ yum gyi mngal na bzhugs dus rdzu 'phrul gyi bzhugs nas pho brang ya mtshan can khang brtsegs kyi rnam pa can de/ da lta lha yul na bzhugs pa dang*/

thun mong gi gdul bya gsung ba'i tshe/ yul dus so sor gnang ba'i skyes rab bris sku shas che ba dang*/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis bzhengs pa'i sku dang*/ de nas mchod rten brgyad dang*/ sku gdung cha brgyad kyi mchod rten dang*/ bya rgod phung por sher phyin gsungs pa'i dus kyi bkod pa dang*/ rgyud sde so so'i gleng gzhi dang mthun par/ blos bslangs kyi dkyil 'khor/ u rgyan dang*/ sham+bha la na bzhugs pa sogs dang*/ dbang phyug tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i sku gsum gyi rten la sogs pa da lta mi mjed kyi zhing 'di na bzhugs pa ji snyed pa de thams cad kyi rnam pa tshang zhing*/ so so las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar can rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' dag mtshon nus pa'i rten mchog srid pa gsum gyi gtsug rgyan gyi nor bu rang re'i rigs rgyud kyis bsgrub par/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis/ snying rje chen po pad dkar las lung bstan pa de nyid slar yang mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi ched du/ bkod pa sngar byon rnams las kyang phul du phyin pa zhig 'phral du bskrun par bya dgongs te/ de yang spangs gzungs su thugs dam gyi ngang nas ston pa sangs rgyas dang mngon sum du mjal ba dang*/ thog kha gser khang du mnyam med sgam po pa dang mjal nas/ rten 'brel bsgrigs par gnang ba dang*/ ka tshal du thugs rje chen po dang mjal ba dang*/ khra ba khar mdo sngags kyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang mjal ba dang*/ mtshe'u khar chos skyong bya rog gdong can dang*/ yang gser khang du ye shes mgon po gser mdog can gyis bka' nod pa dang*/ ti sgro ru gu ru dang mjal/ sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnang ba byung ba de rnams/ thugs kyi skad cig la slar yang thugs su shar zhing*/ sngon skyob pas sgam po gdar gyi ri la bkra shis sgo mang gi gzigs snang mkha' 'gro mas phul ba de yang*/

dus skad cig la dran zhing thugs yul gsal thebs nas/ da ni zhal mthong gi bla ma yi dam de rnams kyi bka' lung dang*/ dgongs pa dang*/ rten 'brel bzang pos/ rang res sngar gyi bya ba'i 'phro can bkra shis sgo mang khyad par can zhig myur du rang gsar du bskrun zhing byin gyis brlab par bya dus yin la/ bya ba 'di lta bu ni thub bstan rgyas shing*/ skye 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i thabs khyad par can yin no snyam du dgongs pa de'i tshe/ bka' sdod chos srung rnams kyis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ rnam 'gyur yang phul bar gyur to// de nas ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du sku'i dbon dang*/ thugs sras kyi mchog rnams dang nye gnas chen po rnams la bka' bstsal yang rim par byon to// dgongs pa sngon du btang ba de nyid ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du bsgrub pa'i nye gnas chen po dbon mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bgyi ba de ni/ rje btsun rin po che 'di nyid kyi sku'i bsod nams las 'khrungs shing*/ gsung tshig gi zur tsam yang*/ dus skad cig tu mi yol bar lus dang longs spyod thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su gtong ba tshig tsam du mi 'dus par brtson 'grus kyi shugs stobs 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rta mchog dang glang po rin po che'i yon tan gyi dpes mtshon pa mnga' la/ thugs bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba mi phyed pa'i dad pa rgyal po gsal rgyal lta bu'i brtul zhugs dang yang ldan la/ spyir rang bzhin gyis drang zhing gzhung bzang la bla ma'i thugs zin pa dang*/ log 'dren tshar gcod pa la dpa' zhing brtul phod pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa yang nges par 'dzin pa zhig tu yod la/ zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod dang dbang thang gi mtho yang khengs pa med la/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen por gyur pa ni/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi ngo mtshar la yang 'gran nus pa'o// mdor na phyogs ris pa'i 'bangs rnams byams pas skyong ba dge bsnyen gyi brtul zhugs can la/

thugs kyi ting nge 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar yang bzhugs shing*/ smon lam gyi nus pas bstan pa stobs kyi 'dzin pa por gyur pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin/ sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'bring ba de nyid/ da lta lha mi'i yul so so na gnas gtan bcu drug so so'i nye gnas tshul du bzhugs/ dharma ta zhes pa'i sprul pa nges pa de nyid kyis/ bla ma rin po che'i rdo rje'i gsung*/ dad pa'i gtsug tu blangs/ ji lta ba bzhin sgrub par dam bcas te/ khyu mchog ces bya ba lcags mo sbrul gyi lo/ yar gyi tshes 'grub sbyor bzang po'i nyin dpon slob rig byed pa dang bcas pa las smon lam dag pa sku 'khor bcas kyis/ mthil gyi sgo mang rnying pa rnams bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang*/ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal med chen po der phyag phebs/ rin po che nyid kyis thugs dgongs pa zab mo la mnyam par bzhag mkhan slob gsum la sogs pa'i sbyin bdag chen po dang*/ bu slob chen po rnams dang*/ rig byed pa dpon g.yog rnams sngar gyi rnying pa'i chag tshad bzo khyad rnams la thugs gzhig legs par bcug da gdod bsgrub par 'gyur ba'i rten mchog gi chag tshad bkod pa bzo khyad la sogs pa ji ltar du bgyid cing bsgrub ces pa'i bka' mchid kyang*/ rin po che'i drung du zhu ba'i skabs de nyid na/ thog mar nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa sprin dang ser bu la sogs pa med pa la/ nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis kun tu gsal zhing spud par gyur pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di mtha' dag in+d+ra nī la'am/ bai ḍūr+ya'i gdugs kyis khebs pa lta bur gyur to/ /'di ni kun khyab rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas dri mas ma gos pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gshis sam babs la bzhugs pa'i mtshon byed do/ /de'i rjes thog zhig na ni/ ri bo dang bar snang gi mtshams nas/ chu 'dzin gzhon nu dar yug dkar po brkyang ba lta bur rnam pa can ji snyed pa dag gis/

ra ba ltar 'khor ba dang*/ gur khyim ltar phub pa dang*/ ut+pal ltar 'dab chags la phyogs dang mtshams dag la ni/ bkra shis pa'i rtags dpal gyi be'u dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba dang*/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang bum pa la sogs pa'i dbyibs can dang*/ bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams rang gi zhing khams na chos ston pa dang*/ byang chub sems pa rnams chos kyi gleng slong ba dang*/ ngur smrig can gyi dge 'dun rnams smon lam dang bden stobs brjod pa dang*/ khro bo rnams gdug pa can tshar gcod pa dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams rdo rje'i glu len zhing gar bsgyur ba dang*/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lha klu rnams kyang bstan pa srung bar khas len pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ mdor na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs 'phrin las kyi rnam par rol pa brjod kyis mi lang ba dag gi rnam pa can rnams/ skyes bu khyad par can sgrub pa po mchog dang*/ rtsa rlung dwangs ma dag gis ni mngon sum du mthong la/ skye bo phal rnams kyis kyang bar snang sprin tshogs kyi rnam pa la 'dra la 'dra min/ phyed 'khrul phyed ma 'khrul lta bu'i rnam pas kun gyi spyod yul du gyur to// gzhan yang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon dang*/ sgra dang 'od la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin no// 'di ni rigs sad pa nas brtsams pa'i lam lnga sa bcu'i yon tan dang*/ gsang sngags la rdo rje'i ra gur sogs bsrung ba'i 'khor lo nas brtsams te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa mtha' dag dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag gi yang mtshon byed du go bar bya'o// yang dus der gzhu lung pa'i thad kyi bar snang ni/ kha dog sna tshogs pa rnam par bkra ba'i 'ja'i gur gyis khebs par gyur la/ khyad par mtshe'u kha bde mchog pho brang dang*/ mthil gyi mi 'gyur lhun grub kyi gtsug lag khang ni 'ja' thag gis sbrel cing*/ mthil gyi rgyab ri spos ngad ldan gyi steng drang thad la ni/

'ja' tshon lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa'i mi nub rgyal mtshan gnam du sgreng ba lta bu dang*/ de'i rtsa ba nas gyes shing song ba lta bu'i tshul gyis/ shar rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga dang*/ tsā ri tsa gong gi thad/ lho dpal gyi ri bo dang*/ la phyi chu dbar gyi thad/ nub u rgyan dang*/ gangs ri'i rgyal po ti se'i thad/ byang sham+bha la dang*/ 'phags pa shing kun gyi thad so rnams su ni dpag bsam shing gi sdong po las yal ga dang lo 'dab tshad med rgyas pa'i tshul lta bu/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thad ka dang*/ rgyas par ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi steng gi nam mkha' yongs su rdzogs par khebs par yang gyur to// 'di ni skyob pa 'di nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis grub pa'i dri bzang khyad par can rna ba'i dbang po tshim par byed pa dag gis/ yul phyogs de kun tu khyab par gyur la/ lha rdzas kyi me tog sna lnga'i char bab pa ni phal pa kun gyi yang spyod yul du gyur la/ gdul bya las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis/ sangs rgyas zhing bkod sogs kyang mthong mod zhib tu bri bar ma nus la/ ri khrod kyi sgrub sde de nyid na/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sgom chen rnams la/ sngar las phul du phyin pa'i nyams dang rtogs pa ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po dus de nyid du skyes la/ gzhan ti sgro dang*/ tsha 'ug dang*/ sgru sgang sogs/ gzhu lung nyid kyi sgrub gnas dang*/ khra ba kha/ dkar leb sogs klung shod kyi sgrub gnas dang*/ mtsho brag dang*/ mtha' brag dkar sogs grog nang gi sgrub gnas dang*/ theg phyi dang*/ lho brag sogs mal gro'i sgrub gnas te/ mdor na dbu ru'i stod 'di nyid kyi/ g.ya' khrod/ gangs khrod/ ri sul/ sman ljongs/ nags tshal/ yang dben/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa'i gnas khyad par can rnams na/ sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa grangs las 'das pa rnams la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can/

dus de nyid du skyes par gyur te/ rgyas par ni/ gangs ti se la sogs gnas mchog gsum gyi gtsos pa'i gangs can gyi ljongs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhis mtshon pa'i gnas khyad par can/ mi mjed kyi zhing na gang yod de rnams na dwags po bka' brgyud pas mtshon pa'i gdul bya khyad par can sgrub pa la brtson pa gang dang ci yod rnams la/ bstan pa lo lnga brgya phrag bcu'i nang nas sgrub pa'i lnga brgya pa gsum gyi sgo skal can de nyid las/ skabs 'dir nyams dang rtogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can dus skad cig ma nyid du stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ lhar bcas skye dgu la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur/ skyob pa rin po ches ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ rten mchog ngo mtshar can 'di la gsol ba btab na/ dgos 'dod thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba'i snga ltas su byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ dus de'i tshe skye dgu mtha' dag kyang lo legs pa/ nad yams dang bral ba/ 'khrug long gi g.yeng pa las thar ba/ rigs kyi gnyen dang*/ mdza' bo dang*/ 'khor g.yog rnams dang rang rang gi skal pa las ji ltar grub pa bzhin du lhan cig pa'i dga' ba dang*/ spro ba dang rnal du phebs pa dang*/ yo byad kyis mi phongs pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don rnams bsams pa bzhin 'byor la/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyu 'bras la yang yid rton par gyur pas so// 'di dag gi rgyu mtshan phyi ma'i dus la phan phyir da dung bshad dgos pa mang yang*/ da lta'i dus na kun gyi mthun snang grub pas chog pa'i dbang du byas la/ yi ge mang dogs nas de tsam du bsdus so// yang dus de nyid du skye 'gro'i yid du 'ong ba'i g.yu 'brug gi sgra skad 'jam por yang grags la/ char zim zim bu dag kyang yun ha cang mi ring bar bab/ sa chen 'di thams cad skyob pa'i thugs rje'i char sprin las thon pa'i byang chub sems kyi chab kyi brlan par gyur/

'dab chags rnams kyang rtsen zhing rol pa'i rnam pas 'khor zhing lding ba dang*/ yid du 'ong ba'i skad snyan sna tshogs sgrog dpon slob yon mchod sgrub pa po 'khor bcas la skrag pa dang*/ dngangs pa dang*/ 'dzem bag gi tshul cung zad kyang med par bag phebs pa'i tshul gyis bka' mchid rnams kyang nyan par gyur to// de bzhin ri dwags kyi tshogs rnams kyang*/ ri dang chu dang nags tshal gyi khrod du bag 'khums pa med par rtsed 'jo'i tshul gyis bka' mchid nyan pa'i bar snga ma ltar gyur to// gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i gtam du bya ba brjod rgyu mang ste/ mtshon pa tsam mo/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po nyid slar bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rang nyid kyi cho 'phrul de lta bu ston bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bu slob kyi thu bo rnams dang*/ dpon mo che 'khor dang bcas pa la rdo rje'i gsung bden pa'i tshig tu bka' bstsal ba ni/ phan pa dang bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu gcig pu ni/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na yin la/ de 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i rnam thar phyag rjes bzang po la rag las/ rang re'i brgyud pa dang*/ bka' bab 'di yang*/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lung bstan pa ltar/ snyigs ma'i sems can mgon skyabs dang bral ba rnams la gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs brtse ba chen pos kun nas blangs te/ sa phyogs gzhan du/ gang zag sus kyang mdzad par rngo ma thogs pa'i rten mchog khyad par can/ 'jig rten na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i bkra shis sgo mang zhes mtshan du gsol ba/ don dus gsum gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku tshab/ de nyid las mi gzhan zhing tha mi dad pa/ phyi dbyibs mchod rten chen po/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams 'og min chen po'i mtshon byed can/ nges pa'i don du rdo rje'i lus/

sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i zhing sa 'di yang mtshon nus pa/ nang gi gnas so sor bla ma grub thob/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ chos skyong srung ma/ zhing skyong pho nya las mkhan dang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la grags tshod kyi sku yongs su rdzogs par tshang bas/ bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ 'od gsal stong nyid chos sku'i yon tan thams cad kyang mtshon pa can/ nges pa'i don du nang rtsa rlung khams gsum rnam par dag pa'ang brda 'phrod cing nges pa drangs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i rten 'brel can/ mdor na gang la gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i rten mchog khyad par can zhig khyad gzhi snga ma rnams las kyang rgya khyon lha grangs mang khyad sogs lhag cing phul du phyin pa rang cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas bsgrub par bya'o// zhes khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bcas/ 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrags so// smras pa/ sngon dus thub chen bya rgod phung po'i rir// rgyal yum sher phyin sgo mang bzhengs bzhed tshe// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing gi mchod pa bzhes// zhing 'di'i mi khom dal 'byor khang par bcug /deng dus skyob pas 'bri sa'i ri bo la// rten mchog sgo mang bzhengs par dgongs gtad tshe// nyer bzhi'i yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod// snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams skal pa bzang por bsgyur// e ma thub chen sangs rgyas dang*// khyed cag 'gran pa'i rol rtsed 'dis// bdud rnams dpa' 'khums yi mug na'ang*// skal ldan mi rnams bde skyid gyur// ces so/ /de lta bu'i rten 'brel khyad par can gyi lo rgyus rnams/ dus de dang nye ba zhig na/ kho bos kyang skyob pa rin po che'i rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen zhabs kyi drung du song te/ bka' mchid gleng bslang zhing zhus pa'i tshe/ dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du gsungs te/

rang nyid kyi yab mes kyi bka' srol bzang po 'di lta bu bsgrub pa'i 'dun pa bstan pa dang*/ sems can la phan par 'gyur ba 'ba' zhig gis lhag pa'i bsam pa gser lta bu de/ ji ltar bsams pa bzhin 'grub pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par/ lha'i rdzas kyi mchod pa khyad par can mi rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong ba dang*/ ya mtshan pa'i bye brag mang po snang ba/ bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyang mgu ba'i rnam par 'dug gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyu tshogs rnams/ rang shugs kyis 'bad med byung tshul dang*/ bkod pa dang bzo khyad sogs lha grangs dang bcas pa snga dus kyi rnams las kyang*/ lhag par rim gyis 'grub pa yod tshul gyi bka' mchid kyang phebs par gyur to// de nas lo de nyid kyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i nyin par bzo thab btsugs nas/ bya lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer bzhi phan chod kyi lo hril po bzhi dang*/ zla ba lnga song ba'i nang du/ phyi nang gi bzo khyad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ chos skyong bang rim gyi rgyal po chen po bzhi legs par byon pa'i rnam thos sras kyi sku/ mi bsrun log smra tshar gcod pa'i mdung rno ngar shugs can dus rtag tu phas rgol la bsnun pa dang*/ dgos 'dod char chen po 'bebs pa'i yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan/ srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba mtshon byed du/ dus rtag tu 'phyar thabs su bsnams pa'i rdzu 'phrul can grub/ tshes lnga nas nang gzhug pa phal ba nas brtsams te/ tshes bcu'i bar la sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i rab gnas skyob pa rin po che rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa/ 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po dang bcas te legs par grub pa'o// skabs de dag tu yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can dag byung ba zur tsam brjod par bya ste/ thog mar lugs phud la/

bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ mtshan dwags po lha rje zhes nyi ma ltar grags pa bzhin du/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sprul par byon pa de nyid kyi sku rgya mtho gang ba'i tshad can rin po che las grub pa zhig gi lugs blug pa'i dgongs pa gnang ba'i snga nub/ sprul sku rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi rmi lam du/ nam mkha'i mthongs mtho la yangs pa'i dbus na/ spyan snga rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen pa 'di nyid/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ gur kum ku sha ris kyi chos gos sum brtsegs dang ldan pa/ ta hūṃ gser ma'i sgom zhwa gsol ba/ phyag na tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa la/ 'khor gur kum ku sha ris kyi sku chos dang na bza' gsol ba dbu reg zhabs rjen mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa/ g.yon kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gdugs 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyis bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs shing*/ ya mtshan mchog tu gyur pa'i rten 'di ma grub kyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi'o// gsungs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i mod la mnal sad de/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos kyis phyag gnas mdzad pa'i mos gus dang yid ches par gyur to// rab gnas dngos gzhi'i nyin par yang*/ sngon dge slong ba'i bka' bgros dang dgongs pa gnang ba'i dus dang chos mtshungs par/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim/ me tog gi char/ dri bzang 'thul ba la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba byung ba rnams/ da lta ni sku 'khor ba thams cad la mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di nyid yin la/ phyis 'byon rnams la yid ches pa'i gtam brjed tho tsam du bkod pa'o// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen zhabs kyi thugs dam sgo mang gi gleng gzhi ngo mtshar bstan pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //kun dga'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin rin chen dpal// thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtser gsol nas// dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po 'bri gung pa// brgyud par bcas bstod le'u gsum pa bri// de la rten mchog 'di'i dkar chag gi snying po sgril na che ba drug dang ldan te/

bzo phud 'phrin las kyi che ba/ rgyu tshogs 'byor ba'i che ba/ bzo khyad bkod pa'i che ba/ lha grangs bzhugs tshul gyi che ba/ nang gzhug byin rlabs kyi che ba/ dge mtshan rten 'brel gyi che ba'o// thog mar bzo phud ngo mtshar can byon tshul ni/ mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud ces/ 'dzam gling kun tu nyi ma ltar grags pa/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan nor bu gang de'i thog ma'i srol 'byed pa por/ sangs rgyas nyid dang*/ paṇa chen nā ro pa sogs kyis lung bstan pa/ mdor na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje dang phrin las gcig tu bsdus te/ mi'i tshul bzung ba dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba/ mtshan lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis kyang*/ ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa las skyob par nus pa'i rje btsun rin po che sgam po pa'i sku/ rgyu rin po che las lugs su bskrun pa ngo mtshar can 'di sgrub par mdzad de/ de nyid thog mar bsgrub pa'i dgongs pa yang*/ rje btsun de nyid rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can dang ni sku skye ba tshe rabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa'i thugs kyi nyams snang mang po sku tshe 'di nyid la yang dang yang du gsal thebs shing de'i 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bsgrub par yang zhal gyis bzhes pa/ deng sang sems can dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ dus dang*/ tshe dang*/ lta ba'i snyigs ma ste/ snyigs ma lnga po ches shin tu bdo ba'i dus kyi gdul bya 'di rnams la bu sdug chus khyer ba'i ma lta bur/ lhag par thugs brtse ba chen po 'khrungs nas/ dwags po rin po che la gsol ba btab na/ gdul bya 'di rnams la dngos su phan pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yang rmi lam du sgam po rin po che dang mjal nas/ mu tig snyim pa gang gnang ste/ 'di khyod kyi grwa pa yin gsung byung ba sogs te rgyu mtshan gzhan yang mang du yod do// rgyu'i rang bzhin gyi khyad par ni/

gser sa le sbram dang*/ 'dzam bu'i chu gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs dang*/ rin po che rdo rje pha lam dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ shel dang*/ me shel dang*/ chu shel dang*/ man shel dang*/ shel bhe du dang*/ byi ru dang*/ spug dang*/ rdo'i snying po dang*/ dung g.yas su 'khyil ba dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ ju ne dang*/ g.yu dang*/ sbur sdud dang*/ sbur len dang*/ mu tig dang*/ mu tig dmar po dang*/ spos shel dang*/ rin po che dang*/ rgya shel dang*/ rin po che mu sa ra dang*/ in+d+ra nī la dang*/ karke ta dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ marga ta dang*/ so'u ghan+dhe dang*/ in+d+ra rnyil dang*/ bu ka ti la dang*/ tam+bha la dang*/ mu men dang*/ ma na ho la sogs pa mdor na lha'i rdzas dang mi'i rin po che sna tshogs pa las ji ltar 'os su legs par brdungs pa dang*/ lugs su btab dang*/ 'phrul du phul ba dang*/ phra bkod pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrubs pa'o// bkod pa'i khyad par la mtha' skor gyi rgyar ni/ rgya mtho brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ mtho dman gyi dpangs kyi char rgyar mtho brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa/ 'dul ba lung gnas mal gyi gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ lta bas chog mi shes shing*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du pad+ma'i ldum rdzing 'khor ba'i steng*/ lha bzhugs pa'i bang rim bdun gyi steng du yang pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan bzhugs dang*/ sngon gyi gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi mtshon byed byin rlabs can skabs 'dir yang bzhugs pa de yang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ pad+ma'i gdan la sogs pa bdun gyi steng na/ pu ri'i rnam pa rgya dpangs can/ bre 'am mgul dang*/ rtse phran gdugs rim pa bcu gsum/ char khebs tog la yang pad+mo bya ru'i rnam pa can/ dar dpyangs zla ba nyi ma rin po che dbang gi rgyal po 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhin pa legs par grub cing bzhugs pa'o// 'di nyid phyi'i bkod dbyibs ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su bzhugs la/

nang chos dbyings kyi pho brang ring bsrel gyi bzhugs gnas/ bar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ste/ mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i yi dam gyi bzhugs gnas su grub pa'o// de yang spyi'i rnam pa la bltas shing skal ldan gyi blo la rags par 'char ba ni khri gdan yan chad la/ chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ 'og min chen po na nges pa lnga ldan gyi tshul gyis dus rtag tu theg pa chen po'i chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa dang 'dra ste/ de nyid kyi khyad chos rnams kyang legs par tshang bas so// yang sprul pa'i sku mchod rten chen po brgyad dang*/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten lta bu dang*/ dpal yon tan can dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sngags nas gsungs pa ji snyed pa'i mchod rten gyi chag tshad kyang phal cher dngos dang shugs kyis mtshon nus pa sprul pa'i sku ste/ dper na/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi lhun grub gru bzhi kun nas mi mnyam pa med par ye nas gnas pa'i mthil gyi gzhir rdo rje'i rgya gram sra zhing brtan pa'i lte ba la/ pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba 'khrungs pa'i pad 'dab rnams la yang lha bzhugs shing ldum rdzing gi 'khyil bar rnams su/ glang chen mjing pa bsnol ba zung dang*/ rta mchog zung du rtse ba/ mdzes pa'i rma bya zung dag gar byed pa/ 'jo sgeg can gyi shang shang zung yang dal gyis 'khod pa/ thogs pa med pa'i dung bsgril ma dang*/ gser gyi nya rgyug skor byed pas spras pa'i yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus gyi pad+ma'i sdong po chen po las thon pa'i phyogs bzhir yal ga chen po bzhi las glang po che'i sna dang 'dra ba'i sdong bu so so las kyang me tog gi gang bu chen po 'od zer chags pa'i rtse mor rin po che 'bar ba'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yod de/ de yang rgyal ba'i sku'i sdong bu/

yid bzhin gyi nor bu las/ dgos 'dod sna tshogs chos kyi char 'beb pa 'dra'o// de nas pad+ma chen po'i steng rab tu rgyas pa'i steng na/ bang rim rim pa drug tu yod pa las bang rim gyi bar rnams la/ ngos re re la ling tshe lnga lnga/ ling tshe re re la ngos dgu dgu/ de dag gi dbus na lha rnams bzhugs shing ling tshe re la ka ba zung re/ kha gdong dang*/ len kan dang*/ rdo rje'i gdung rgyud la/ pad+ma dang rin po che'i rigs/ nor bu me shel du ma dang*/ mdzes pa'i ri dwags dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gdug can/ ngos thams cad la/ rin po che'i drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pas nyis rim du g.yogs shing rin po che dang nyi zla spel ma ris su byas pa'i chun 'phyang kho ra yug tu bres pa/ zla gam lta bus kyang mdzes par brgyan pa'i bla gab can du phub pa/ gzhal med khang pa brtsegs ma kho ra yug tu yod pa ltar na mngon te/ de ltar spyi'i rnam pa la bltas na ni/ logs bzhi zur bzhi dang ldan pa/ steng spyi bsdus rin po che'i za ma tog gis mdzes pa'i rnam pa can bstan pa spyi la grags pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po dang 'dra ba lta bu'o// bang rim so sor logs dang ngos ji ltar rigs pa rnams la/ lha bzhugs pa'i sgo mang gis shin tu mdzes par gyur pa ni thub chen bltams pa'i dus kyi dpal bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten gyi rnam pa lta bu'o// zur bzhi logs brgyad dang ldan pa las logs dang*/ zur rnams phyed phyed du gong 'og rim pa ma 'dres par gsal ba'i dbus na/ bum pa yan chad thal ler mngon par 'phags pa ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su yum don du zla ba gsum dbyar gnas mdzad pa las/ dgag dbye'i nyin par 'dzam bu'i gling du phebs pa'i lam la rin po che'i skas btsugs pa'i rnam pa can/ dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten dang yang 'dra'o// 'od dang 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro ba mtshan mo ri bo'i spo la me sbar ba bzhin ma 'dres yongs rdzogs lham mer gsal ba byams dngos dpal yon can dang 'dra la/

khri 'phang bzhi'i steng dbus dril stabs su gnas pa byang chub dang*/ myang 'das dang yang cha 'dra la/ yar gyi pad+ma chen po zlum skor gyi dbus na lham mer brjid pa/ yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa rnam par rgyal ba lta bur bzhugs/ khri 'phang bum pa dang bcas pa tsam las chos kyi 'khor lo'i don yang legs par tshang la/ steng gi bum pa rab tu zlum pa du ba lta bur bzhugs shing*/ gtso bor ni rgyal chen bzhir bkod cing*/ dbus kyi rtse mo mngon par mtho ba gnyan yod du cho 'phrul bstan nas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis brlabs pa/ cho 'phrul chen po nyid kyi rnam par bzhugs so// de bzhin du bya ba'i rgyud rnam par rgyal ma lta bu'ang mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs par gsungs pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar yang bzung du yod mod/ ha cang yang yi ge mang dogs kha byang tsam mo// de bzhin du zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams re re nas bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan rin po ches kun nas rnam pa thams cad du brgyan pa'i mtshon byed du/ phyogs bzhi'i phyogs re re'i ngos la yang*/ logs chen bzhi logs thung bzhi bzhi dang ldan pas mdzes la yar gyi pad+ma gyen du bskyor ba ze hrog tshul du yod pa'i dbus na/ kun khyab rnam pa thams cad pa'i gdung khang gi rnam pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bzhugs la/ lha so so ni/ gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par zhal phyag rgyan dang rnam 'gyur rigs mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mdor na sku gsung thugs rgyan gyi 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin mtshon par nus pa'o// zhes bya ba ni re zhig bkod pa'i khyad par te/ zhib mor 'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur ro// da ni lha grangs kyi bzhugs tshul dang*/ go rim grangs dang bcas pa brjod par bya ste/ sngon gyi rnams la rgyud sde bzhi'i go rim yang*/

ha cang gsal po mi snang ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu rtsod bral chen po gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs cher mi bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhugs pa dag kyang go rim 'chol ba dag cung zad snang la/ grangs kyang nyis stong bdun brgya skor las mi bzhugs pa shas che la/ 'dir ni rin po che nyid kyi bka' dang dgongs pas/ snga ma rnams las bang rim gcig gis lhag pa'i rgya dpangs gnyis ka'i cha bskyed nas/ lha grangs kyang nyis stong brgyad brgya lhag cig bzhugs la/ don la bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyang*/ rnam pa'i cha nas thog mar bla ma'i bang rim/ des nas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i bang rim/ sangs rgyas stong gi bang rim/ nang na chos gsung rab kyi bang rim/ phyi'i pad 'dab kyi 'og nas dge 'dun chos skyong gi bang rim can las/ thog mar nyi zla bya ru la skyabs gnas kun 'dus skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i dngul sku bzhugs la/ de nas bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim la/ phyogs bzhi'i ze hrog re re la/ bde mchog yab yum/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsum re tshang la/ snam bu la yang phyogs re re la rdo rje 'chang rigs bzhis bskor ba grub chen brgyad dang bcas pa/ sngar gyi sgo mang rnams dang cha 'dra'i steng du/ 'dir bsnan pa rgya gar gyi grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod kyi bka' brgyud bla ma/ rang re'i brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa khri thog gi rim pa dang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa/ jo gdan chos lung pa'i mkhan chen lnga sogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bcu phrag lhag bcas jo bo 'brom dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ yi dam bang rim la gsang sngags rnying ma'i bka' brgyad gtso bo/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ che mchog yon tan/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo sbod gtong*/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod dang*/ rig 'dzin bla ma dang*/ gsar ma'i rnal 'byor bla med kyi pha rgyud gsang 'dus/
