gshin rje gshed/ 'jigs byed/ phyag na rdo rje/ ma rgyud bde mchog gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ gnyis med rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo ba'i lha tshogs rnams rigs kyi dbye bas/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams spel mar ji ltar rigs par bzhugs su gsol te/ gsar rnying rnams kyang spel la/ thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud kyang spel ba lta bur bkod pas re re bzhin yang gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'o// bang rim gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bang rim la/ shar gyi lha rnams gtso bor rgyud kyi bshad tshul dang bstun te/ rigs lnga so sor 'khor bcas rdor dbyings dang bcas pa/ de nyid bsdus pa rtsa bshad cha mthun dang bcas pa'i dgongs par bzhugs/ phyogs gzhan rnams la/ grub chen so sos bkral ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor shas cher bzhugs/ bang rim bzhi pa spyod rgyud la gtso bo rnams rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud ltar bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa las/ 'khor byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ gnas brtan bcu drug sangs rgyas stong tshang ba dang bcas pa/ phyogs so sor bkod pa'i khyad par rigs so so dang mthun par bzhugs la/ 'dir khro bcu'i mtshan don ni rnying ma dang gsar ma'i rgyud sde bzhi char la grags kyang*/ sku mdog sogs kyi khyad par/ rgyud sde gang dang gang gi chos skad dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i gtso bo'i dbang gis mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ bde gsang dus gsum las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa shas che la/ kyai rdor du zhal gcig phyag gnyis thabs shes zung 'jug lta bu las/ rnying ma las/ don 'di nyid la mtshan dang cha lugs gzhan du bsgyur zhing*/ de bzhin dgra nag 'jigs gsum sogs las kyang 'byung mod/ 'dir bzhugs pa ni/ spyod rgyud las gshin rje gshed dang*/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ 'dod rgyal dang*/ stobs po che sogs kyi rtogs pa 'byung bas/ de nyid la gtso bor dgongs shing*/

spyir du'ang spyod rgyud 'di rnal 'byor gong 'og bsres pa lta bu'ang yin pas/ tshul gzhan yang 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan no// de bzhin du byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad/ mtshan nyid theg par yang grags mod/ rgyud sde bzhi char dang 'brel la/ sku mdog sogs kyang snga mas mtshon te/ bde mchog rkyang pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi la yang grub chen so so'i bzhed pa la khyad par byung ba lta bu ste/ 'dir snga ma bzhin no// gnas brtan bcu drug gtso bor mdo las bshad kyang*/ sngags su yo ga'i 'gron thabs kyi lha la'ang*/ nyan thos bcu drug dang*/ rang rgyal bcu gnyis 'god par gsungs pas mtshon no// de bzhin du sangs rgyas stong po bskal bzang gi mdo sogs las byung ba paṇa chen shākya shrīs gsal bar yang mdzad pas/ mdo lugs yin la/ sngags su 'grel ba ni/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs su gsungs pas/ bla med du yang mi 'gal/ rdor dbyings su lha snam la stong du bzhis chag 'god pas/ rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang rung*/ gtso bor rnam snang mngon byang dang bstun nas 'dir bkod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang snga ma bzhin no// sman lha'i lha tshogs kyang tshul 'dis mtshon par nus so// bang rim lnga pa bya rgyud la ri khrod lo ma can ma la sogs pa'i lha mo dang*/ rnam rgyal la sogs pa bzhugs par mdzad de/ de ltar gzhung na ji ltar bzhugs pa bzhin rgya bod tshad ldan mang pos bkral ba ltar te/ dper na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho sogs dang cha mthun pa'o// de nas 'khor pad kyi 'og bdun pa chos skyong bang rim la/ mdo rgyud man ngag rnams nas byung ba'i chos skyong ji snyed pa bzhugs pa la yang*/ rgyud sde sogs kyi go rim yod mod/ phyis su 'chad par 'gyur ro// mthar phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi bzhugs pa/ ston pas rgyal chen bzhi po la bstan pa'i gnyer kha bcol ba'i mtshon byed/ cho 'phrul gyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa/

bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel can no// srid pa gsum na dpe med rnam thar gyis// 'bri sa'i gling la cho 'phrul chen po bzhengs// lha mi 'gro ba kun gyis rab mchod pa'i// bstan pa rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas lha'i bzhugs tshul go bde bar bkod pa/ thog mar nyi zla bya ru dang bcas pa chos rje bla ma skyob pa rin po che'i dngul sku/ khri drug 'gyogs/ rgyan rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa/ rgyu dngul dkar dri ma med pa shing srang gi nyag nyi shu rtsa brgyad las gar lugs su bskrun pa/ dbu gtsug na sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang bcas pa bzhugs te/ 'di ni phyogs bcu'i zhing khams tshad med pa na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed bzhugs pa/ rten mchog 'di'i rnam pas mtshon pa de thams cad kyang*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon nyid kyi ye shes las spros shing ye shes su 'du ba zhes bya ba'i rnam par ngo shes shing*/ brda 'phrod pa'i phyir du/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa nyid kyis/ nga nyid mtha' 'khob tu zhing srung gi tshul gyis/ nga'i bstan pa spel du 'ong zhes lung bstan pa'i mgon po 'bri gung pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i sku rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa can du bzhugs pa'o// pu ri'i phyi rol gyi ya pad lha bzhugs pa'i gnas/ phyogs bzhi'i dbus kyi ze rog dbus ma'i 'og bzhi po la/ bde mchog yab yum zung 'jug lugs ma bzhi bzhugs pa la/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro 'phrul ma bzhi bzhi dang*/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lugs ma gsum gsum gyis bskor ba ste/ yongs sgril 'khor lo sdom pa bzhi/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis/ mkha' 'gro bcu drug ste sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs so// 'di dag gi dag pa yang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa bzhi po ni/ rgyu'i dbang bzhi/ lam gyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ 'bras bu'i sku bzhi/ gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma sbyong ba/ skye gnas bzhi'i bag chags sel ba/

phrin las bzhi'i dgos pa 'grub pa/ mdor na phyi yi 'byung ba bzhi/ dus chen bzhi/ nang gi rtsa 'khor bzhi/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab bzhi/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' bzhi/ rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba las ji ltar gsungs pa'i mtshon byed du bzhugs la/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis kyang*/ bden don bcu gnyis mtshon pa ste/ phyi ru sa dum bu bcu gnyis dang khyim bcu gnyis/ nang du snying kha'i phyi skor rtsa brgyad nang skor bzhi dang bcas pa/ yang lte ba'i bar skor bcu gnyis/ gzhan la rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis/ sa bcu gnyis/ gnas la sogs pa bcu gnyis ste/ bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa bde mchog gi rgyud phal cher du lā ma la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs shing khyad par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i le'u so so las byung ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun par bzhugs pa'o// mkha' 'gro bcu drug ni/ de nyid bcu drug gi mtshon byed de/ phyi ru zla ba'i cha bcu drug nang du 'pho ba bcu drug mgrin pa'am dpral ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gzhan la stong nyid bcu drug snying rje bcu drug dga' ba bcu drug ste/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// zhes pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa'o// de lta bu'i lha so gnyis ni/ phyi ru yul so gnyis// nang du rtsa khams so gnyis/ gzhan la mtshan so gnyis rnam smin gyi yon tan du grags pa dang*/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi/ so so rig bzhi/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de/ bral ba'i yon tan so gnyis su grags pa/ gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis rnam par dag par yang bzhugs pa'o// 'di'i steng du bcom ldan 'das dang zung du 'jug pa'i yum bzhi po bgrangs pa ni/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i chos can so drug gi dag par 'gyur la/ skyob pa'i sku dang sum cu rtsa bdun po ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun po rnam par dag pa ste/

so bdun po 'dis ni/ theg pa gsum gyi chos thams cad bsdus la/ khyad par sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang lha thams cad 'dir 'dus pa rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ bla med spyi dang*/ khyad par bde mchog gi chos skad las 'byung la/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum rjes 'brang dang bcas pa las ni/ rdo rje dbyings kyi lha sum cu rtsa bdun po de 'khor 'das thams cad gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul du khyab par bzhugs pa/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi e waṃ mā yā la sogs pa'i yi ge so bdun gyis ston par bzhed la/ skabs 'dir yang*/ bum gdan yar bcad la gnas pa'i lha so bdun/ thabs shes gcig tu bgrang na so gsum ste/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po/ dpal saṃ bhu ṭi dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas 'byung ba de'i rnam par bzhugs so// mdor na/ gtso bo skyob pa gcig pu de rdo rje 'chang thabs shes gnyis/ thabs rdo rje 'chang rigs bzhi/ shes rab rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ gnyis dang*/ bcu drug tu yang bzhugs pas na/ rigs kyi dbye bsdu mtha' dag la yang nges pa ster ba rgyud sde mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang 'byor te/ gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag dang*// ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba dang*// bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas pa dang*// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mor 'chang dang*// bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan dang*// de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba// zhes gsungs te/ zur tsam bkod pa'o// 'di ni sngar gyi sgo mang rnying pa rnams las/ lha bkod phul du phyin pa'i khyad chos dang po ste/ sngar med kyi ngo mtshar can chos dang mthun pa/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam gyi snying po can no// smras pa/ ston pas sngon med chos 'khor rim par bskor// skyob pas sngon med sgo mang rim par bskrun// lha bkod sngon med kun dga'i thugs las spros// dkar chag sngon med rnam dag can 'di'ang dge// de nas khri gdan sku'i rnam 'gyur/

rgyan cha lugs kyi dag pa rgyas par ni brjod kyis mi lang la snying po tsam ni/ skyob pa dang*/ bde mchog rnams la rgyan sna bzhis bskor ba ni/ g.yas g.yon na stobs bcu mtshon pa'i glang po che dang*/ thugs rje chen po mtshon pa'i rigs dwags kriṣa ṇa sā ra zhes grags pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum mtshon pa'i klu'i rgyal po dang*/ bsrung ba med pa gsum mtshon pa'i mkha' lding gi rgyal pos kyang steng nas brgyan pa'o// thabs shes ya ma bral ba mtshon pa nyi zla'i gdan/ 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa pad+ma'i gdan/ ye shes dang phrin las kyis phyogs kun tu khyab pa rin chen 'ja' 'od kyi phreng ba kun nas 'khrigs pa'o// rang bzhin lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa gser btso ma'i mdog la/ gnas 'gyur ye shes rin po che sna bdun gyi zer phreng 'phro ba/ skyob pa ni bstan pa'i bdag po dge slong gi brtul zhugs can/ bde ba chen po las dus nam yang mi bskyod pa'i dkyil krung*/ bdud 'dul ba'i sa gnon/ chos dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgya can/ chos gos gsum dang sgom zhus brjid par bzhugs pa/ bde mchog yab yum ni/ 'dod yon lam byed khro chags kyi nyams can/ dus gsum la gzigs pa'i spyan/ gar dgu'i nyams/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rgyan/ dbang phyug dang dus mtshan ma'i sgo gsum/ ye shes su rol ba'i zhabs can du bzhugs la/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bzhi po ni gtso bo la tshad med bzhi/ dga' ba bzhi sogs kyi mchod pa 'bul bzhin pa/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ mkha' la spyod pa'i rol rtsed bde stong gi gar nyams thams cad bsgyur bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ sgrub pa po la dus rtag tu gzigs pa'i spyan gsum gyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub da lta nyid du ster bzhin pa'i rnam pas bang rim gyi kha khyer zur bzhi zur can bcu gnyis po las 'phyar thabs su bzhugs pa'o// bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim la/

lha gtso bo nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa bzhugs te/ snam bu'i phyogs bzhi po re re la rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa rgya bod kyi bla ma bcu phrag re dang bcas pa phyogs re la bzhugs la/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon gyi logs la ni/ shar dang lho ngos kyi phyogs la sum cu sum cu dang*/ nub dang byang la nyer brgyad nyer brgyad te/ ka ba'i nang ngos la sems dpa' bzhi bzhi/ phyi ngos la mchod lha bzhi bzhi/ zur thung la lha mo brgyad brgyad/ zur du mi g.yo ba pus btsugs re/ lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum gsum dang bcas pa'o// 'di la yang mtshan don cung zad zhib pa dang*/ rnam dag rags par brjod pa gnyis las/ thog mar lha snam shar gyi dbus su 'og min na chos ston bzhin pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhis bskor ba/ 'di ni rnying ma ltar na yang dag thugs kyi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bdag po/ gsar ma ltar na/ thugs dang he ru ka'i rigs te/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang zhe sdang gi dri ma dag pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yas su rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi thugs las sprul te bka' bab bzhi'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi don mdzad pa grub chen til+li pa bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs su rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i byang sgo srung ba'i bstan pa'i bdag po grub chen nā ro pa bzhugs/ til+li'i g.yas su 'dod yon lam du blangs pa'i rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mi ka ra dang bde stong gis rol par bzhugs/ nā ro'i g.yon du mda' bsnun pa'i zol gyis gnyug ma'i don mtshon pa bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ yum khaṇ+ḍa ro hes mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i brdar g.yas g.yon nas brten pa bzhugs/ rgyal po'i g.yas na bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med sgam po pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs can dwags po lha rje bzhugs/

sa ra ha'i g.yon na in+d+ra bhu ti'i sprul pa phrin las kyi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po bzhugs/ mnyam med kyi g.yas su skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po ston pa sangs rgyas dang thugs rgyud tha mi dad pa'i mtshon byed mnyam bzhag sa gnon ngur smrig gi spyod lam can du bzhugs/ 'gro mgon gyi g.yon du sangs rgyas dbon rin po che bsod nams grags pa bzhugs/ skyob pa'i g.yas su yongs 'dzin gtsang pa dpal ldan rin chen rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi bdud rtsi la rol pa bzhugs/ dbon gyi g.yon du mang thos rin po che dkon mchog rin chen dngos stobs rigs pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa bzhugs/ bang rim 'di nyid kyi shar gyi logs g.yas g.yon la ni/ grub chen nag po brtul zhugs spyod pas gzhan don mdzad de bar dor zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa de dang*/ kar+ṇa pa rgyal rigs dman spyod rigs ngan las rgyas dngos grub brnyes pa yum bcas dang*/ mu la ti pa'am/ pu ta la ka zhes pa dang*/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs brgya phrag ldan pa pha dam pa sangs rgyas pad+ma ā ka ra dge slong lus kyi las rgya la brten te tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pa de dang*/ yugs 'bru a wa dhū ti ba sgrol mas rjes su bzung bas 'jigs pa brgyad las grol ba dang*/ ka ma la rig gnas lnga la mkhas shing tshe'i dngos grub thob pa dang*/ zla ba bzang po bram ze khur po mkhan gyi bsod snyoms pa dang*/ shān+ti pa 'dul 'dzin gsang sngags kyi mnga' bdag dang*/ sha ba ri'i dbang phyug lcam dang*/ zung 'jug gi dngos grub brnyes pas 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ na ta pa u rgyan du dka' thub kyis grub pa dang*/ ā nan+da bram ze rtog med kyi spyod pa la dbang thob pa dang*/ phag tshang pa bram ze dge bsnyen sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba yan lag med pa'i rdo rje dang*/ seng ge pa rgya mtshor dka' thub kyis u rgyan du dngos grub thob pa dang*/

nag po rdo rje lta stangs kyis grub pa dang*/ tog tse ba shing mkhan las rgyas grub pa dang*/ mi na ra pa dge bsnyen rgya mtsho'i gling du grub pa dang*/ yug 'bru can seng ge pa spyan ras gzigs dang mjal bum pas dri ma 'khrud de grub pa dang*/ ā ba la rgyal rigs dur khrod kyi sha chen gsol bas grub pa dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa pa dge slong gcer bu'i spyod pas grub pa dang*/ bha gha na bram ze'i dge slong sbyangs pa bcu gnyis grub pa dang*/ nā ga bho dhi ba lang bskyangs te dpal gyi ri la grub pa klu sgrub kyi yab kyi skye ba klu byang du grags pa dang*/ tran+ta pa bram ze thag mkhan gyis grub pa dang*/ dā ri ka pa rgyal rigs smad 'tshong ma'i zhabs 'bring las grub pa dang*/ pa ri pu ta u rgyan gyi dur khrod du mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung ba dang*/ ma hā de wa lus sna tshogs dur khrod rgyan drug gsol bas grub pa dang*/ bzang po pa/ yul 'dzin pa/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa rnams g.yas g.yon spel te rang rang gi rnam thar bzhin bzhugs so// ka ba bzhi po la ni zhal phyir gzigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' bzhi ste/ pham pa las rgyal ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam rgyal gnyis te/ bzhi ka'ang phyag bzhi dang ldan pas phrin las bzhi bsgrub pa la 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang shing thog shing ka ra/ gong ma gnyis me tog gi phreng ba 'degs bzhin pa'o// nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'ang bzhi ste phyi nang sgril bas brgyad bzhugs pa ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa sogs kyi mtshon byed can no// zur thung bzhi la/ mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma/ gling bu ma/ rnga zlum ma/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ ro rdo rje ma/ reg rdo rje ma/ chos khams rdo rje ma rnams bzhugs pa ni/ 'phags lam yan lag sogs kyi don can no// zur du lha'i bu'i bdud 'joms pa'i mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/

sgo gsum nam mkha' mdzod la dbang ba'i lha phrug gsum bzhugs te/ phyogs shar gyi ngos dang logs la lha drug cu rtsa lnga bzhugs so// de nas lho'i ngos dang logs la yang*/ tshul de dang cha 'dra ste/ lho'i dbus na rdo rje 'chang mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa ni/ rnying ma ltar na 'jam dpal sku'i rig 'dzin/ gsar ma ltar na/ sku dang rin chen gyi rigs/ gzugs phung gi dri ma rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang gzugs su bzhugs pa'o// g.yas su bod yul gsang sngags kyi shing rta chen po mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā bzhugs/ g.yon du sgrub brgyud 'bras bu'i srol 'byed rje btsun mi la bzhugs/ mar pa'i g.yas su stag la bcibs nas rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i ḍom+bhi he ru kaḥ mi la'i g.yon du klu dang srid sgrub dang chos mtshungs pa'i klu sgrub/ ḍoṃ bhi pa'i g.yas na/ gaṅgā gyen du bzlog cing nyi ma steng par 'dzin pa'i bir+wa pa gtso 'khor gsum/ klu sgrub kyi g.yon du skyob pa'i bka' tshul bzhin nod pa'i gcung rdo rje grags pa/ bir+wa pa'i g.yas su rgyal sras thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ gcung gi g.yon du spyan snga mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams/ thog kha ba'i g.yas su/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen/ logs g.yas g.yon rim par sid+dhi pa yum dang bcas pa'i ka la ka yum dang bcas pa'i ka na pa/ sa ya li pa/ tsan+d+ra go mi 'khor gnyis dang bcas pa/ dur khrod pa yum bcas/ gling bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ dze tā ri yum dang bcas pa/ bhu su ku ste rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa yon tan 'od/ 'dul 'dzin shākya 'od/ thun mong gi grub pa brnyes nas nyi zer la gshegs pa'i ngag dbang grags pa ku ma ra/ 'phags pa lha/ 'phags pa thogs med/ rgyas sras dbyig gnyen/ phyogs kyi glang po/ chos kyi grags pa/ yi ge pa/ seng ge can/ ke kri ri pa/ tsā ri pa yum dang bcas pa/ sgra mkhan zhabs/ tha ga pa/ phag tshang pa/ ku mā ri pa/ rus sbal zhabs/

klu sgrub kyi bstan 'dzin shākya bshes gnyen/ theg chen bstan 'dzin gser gling pa/ rje btsun nyid kyis rab tu byung ba'i chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan po bde mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa kun dga' blo gros rnams bzhugs/ gzhan ka ba'i mchod lha brgyad/ zur thung gi brgyad snga ma dang 'dra la/ lho nub nyon mongs pa'i bdud 'joms pa'i mi g.yo ba pus btsugs/ bsrung ba med pa mtshon pa'i lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum rnams bzhugs so// nub kyi snam bu'i dbus su ni/ rnying ma ltar na pad+ma gsung gi rig 'dzin/ gsar ma ltar na/ gsung pad+ma'i rigs/ 'du shes dang 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag pa'i rang gzugs so// rdo rje chos kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang mkha' 'gro bzhis bskor ba/ g.yas su ni klu sgrub ces grags pa sangs rgyas nyid kyis bstan pa 'dzin par byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bstan yang shin tu mang bar mdzad de thub chen zhi bar gshegs nas/ lo bzhi brgya pa'i dus su sa'i steng du seng ge'i sgra lan gsum bsgrags pas/ bstan pa 'di'i rtsod bral gyi 'phags pa nā gardzu na zhes grags pa de bzhugs/ g.yon na rdzus skyes su byon pa 'phags pa'i thugs sras 'phags pa lha ste ār+ya de wa bzhugs/ 'phags pa'i g.yas na/ las rgya khyi'i tshul gyis bde stong la rol zhing*/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i mdzod nas ma hā mā yā blangs te skal ldan gyi don mdzad pa ku ku ri pa/ 'phags pa lha'i g.yon na bde mchog bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dza lan+dha ra shes rab dang rol pa/ de nas g.yas g.yon spel mar/ rgya gar paṇa chen bka' gdams bstan pa'i srol 'byed/ jo bo rje a ti sha dī paṃ ka ra dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dge bsnyen 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang*/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po/ nyer gnyis pa 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ bco lnga pa don grub rgyal po/ wang rin po che dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/

logs la yang sngar dang 'dra bar/ slob dpon nag po pa/ gu ṇa ri pa/ bha ra bud+dha/ ga ra ṇa pa yum bcas/ ta pa ka pa/ nag po ta pa/ ma he la/ bha bhi la/ 'di pha khol dang ma khol du grags/ rta dbyangs dang gcig te yi ge tsam yang ma nor dgos/ nā len+d+ra pa/ dha si ri pa/ pha wang pa/ gan+dho pa/ a phan+ti pa/ pa ka ra/ dza wa ri pa/ tsan tra li pa/ zla ba pa/ tha ka ki li/ ka lang la/ tsan+d+ra pa tra/ lwa ba pa/ gan+dho li/ ka pā la/ a nan+ta/ ku bu tsa/ dha ri ka pa yum bcas/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po snyigs dus tshul khrims kyi srog shing du gyur pa paṇa chen shākya shrī/ mkhan chen bstan pa ba rnams bzhugs/ snga ma ltar gyi mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis/ nub byang gi zur la/ phung po'i bdud 'joms pa'i mi g.yo ba pus btsugs/ ma 'dres rten pa'i lha phrug gsum rnams kyang bzhugs so/ byang phyogs snam bu'i dbus su ni/ rnying ma ltar na phur pa phrin las gyi rig 'dzin/ gsar ma ltar na las rigs bla ma rin 'byung don grub kyi ngo bo/ 'du byed phung po nga rgyal ser sna phra dog sbyangs pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang gzugs/ rdo rje 'chang mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa/ g.yas su klu sgrub dang mdzad pa mnyam zhing rtsod med kyi grub chen klu'i byang chub/ g.yon du bde mchog gi grub pa brnyes nas chang 'tshong ma las rgyar mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i skur bstan pas rgyal po btul te gsang sngags kyi bdag por gyur pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ klu byang gi g.yas su bstan pa 'di la grub chen kun gyi thog ma/ sngags 'chang thams cad kyi gtso bo pad+ma'i sdong po la 'od dpag med kyi sprul par 'khrungs te mtshan brgyad dang ldan pa/ lhag par bod kha ba can pa'i mgon gcig gnyen gcig skyabs gcig po/ bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa'i sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas u rgyan gu ru zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa bzhugs/ dril bu pa'i g.yon du nya lto'i zas kyis bde mchog grub ste/

rgyal po bi ma la tsan+d+ra btul ba gsang sngags bdag po lū hi pa bzhugs/ gu ru'i g.yas su pad+ma ni dang zung du 'jug pa'i grub chen rtsod med mtsho skyes rdo rje/ lū hi pa'i g.yon du/ bod du chos dar ba'i thog mar bka' drin che ba byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho ste mkhan po bo dhi sa twa grags pa/ mtsho skyes kyi g.yas su chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ mkhan po'i g.yon du/ zas gtsang rgyal po'i tshul gyis rje btsun 'di'i sku'i gdung bskrun pa po bco lnga gsar ma rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yang g.yas na dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ yang g.yon du/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams bzhugs la/ logs g.yas g.yon la'ang rim bzhin spel te/ pa ṭa pu/ til+li pa/ a pa li pa/ zla ba bzang po/ sa ka la pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ bhi na sa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ khu yangs pa yum bcas/ dharma kīrti/ tsār+ya pa/ ni la pa/ tshem bu pa yum bcas/ ka la laṅka/ bha hi na smad dkris can/ tsa pa ni/ ka la nā pa/ kun dga' snying po/ ka la pa/ sprin gyi shugs can/ ka ro pa/ nyi ma sbas pa/ ma pi pa/ tsan+d+ra go mī/ mkhan chen legs rin pa/ mal gro grub chen blo gros dpal ldan pa/ rig 'dzin chen po zla 'od pa rnams bzhugs/ ka ba phyi nang gi mchod lha brgyad/ zur thung gi mchod lha brgyad rnams shar phyogs dang 'dra/ byang shar mtshams su 'chi bdag gi bdud 'joms pa'i mi g.yo ba pus btsugs/ zur rgyan la sgo gsum la 'chi med bdud rtsi ster ba'i lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum rnams bzhugs pa'o// 'di rnams kyi dag pa rgyas par brjod kyis mi lang zhing*/ yi ge yang mang 'gro bas/ zur tsam gyis rgyas pa mtshon nus pa ni/ 'di yan chad bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim ste/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// zhes sogs kyi don can/ gsang sngags snying po lam zab bla mas lam bgrod pa/ zab chos mos gus srog 'khor gyi don yang nges pa kho nar mtshon pa zhig ste/

bang rim 'di yan chad mchod rten lha dang rgyan so so'i rnam pa ma 'dres par gsal ba la/ dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi char pas khebs par ro gcig pa ni ngo bo nyid sku ste/ gshis gang du ma grub kyang*/ mdangs sna tshogs su 'char ba'o// skyob pa ni chos kyi sku thig le nyag gcig dang*/ ze rog skor gyi lha so gnyis/ byang chub sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab pa ni/ longs spyod pa'i sku'o// bang rim gyi lha sku cha lugs sna tshogs pa ni sprul pa'i sku'o// 'di nyid la yang sku bzhi'i yon tan ni/ chos kyi sku'i ye shes brgya dang bzhi bcu/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i yon tan mtshan dpe brgya dang bcu gnyis/ sprul sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis te/ nyis brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi po ni/ 'di'i lha grangs dang 'byor la/ de thams cad ngo bo tha mi dad la rnam pa so sor ma 'dres pa ni ngo bo nyid sku'o// gzhan yang rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// zhes dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// 'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ces sogs phung po lnga rigs lnga/ khams bzhi yum bzhi sogs gsungs pa'ang*/ 'di la mtshon byed du bzhugs te/ phyi ltar rdo rje 'chang rigs bzhi skyob pa dang lnga/ nang ltar bde mchog rigs bzhi re re la yang*/ yum bzhi bzhis bskor ba la sogs pa can no// yang phyi gzhal yas khang la rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad du gsungs pa dang*/ dbang po dang tshigs byang sems dang khro bor yang gsungs la/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad grub chen brgyad du yang gsungs pas/ de thams cad kyang 'dir legs par tshang ste/ spros pas chog go// bang rim dang po 'di yang rnying pa rnams las khyad par 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar gnyis pa'o// da ni rgyud sde bzhi'i bang rim la 'jug par bya ste/

bang rim gnyis pa bla med kyi bang rim 'di la ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad rig 'dzin bla ma'i sku dang*/ gsar ma'i pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams bzhugs pa las/ thog mar shar gyi dbus na rnying ma'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yum dang bcas pa'i rigs bdag gis brgyan pa lugs su byon/ 'khor sum cu rtsa bdun 'phrul mar bzhugs te/ 'di dag gi bzhugs stangs phyag mtshan/ rgyan phra zhib rnams so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin zur du btsal la/ gong 'og kun la'ang des 'gre'o// de nas gsang ba 'dus pa/ rtsa rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa dang*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba la sogs brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu blangs te/ gtso bo rigs lnga la/ 'khor rnams so sor bca' bkram ste/ rtsa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis mchod lha/ mgron thabs dang bcas pa/ spyir bdun cu rtsa bdun gyi 'khor lo bzhugs pa las/ thog mar ni/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa zhe sdang rdo rje yum reg bya rdo rje dang mnyam par zhal gsum phyag drug tu sbyar ba rigs bdag dang bcas pa/ 'khor yum bzhi khro bo gnyis sems dpa' gnyis te brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhugs la/ gtso bo rnams lugs ma dang*/ 'khor rnams 'phrul las grub pa ni/ gong 'og kun tu shes par yang bya'o// g.yas su rnam par snang mdzad/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang sbyor ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa la 'khor drug gis bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa ma mā ki dang sbyor ba/ 'khor drug gis bskor ba bzhugs/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i g.yon du gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gam/ snang ba mtha' yas gos dkar mo dang sbyor ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du gsang 'dus don yod grub pa sgrol ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa zhal gsum phyag drug 'khor drug gis bskor ba bzhugs so// ka ba'i mchod lha brgyad/

zur thung gi mchod lha brgyad dang bcas pa bang rim gong ma dang 'dra la/ shar lho'i mtshams na/ jo bo thugs rje chen po/ yum yig drug ma/ sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang gsum po lugs su byon te bzhugs/ zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum gong bzhin no// lho phyogs dbus su/ gu ru drag po lugs su byon/ gu ru mtshan brgyad dang*/ 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig 'phrul las grub pa/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ che mchog yon tan/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo sbod gtong*/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod brgyad po lugs las byon pa/ 'khor bco brgyad 'phrul las grub pa bzhugs/ de yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed ni/ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ g.yon nas yum bai tā lī dang sbyar ba pad+ma rta mgrin dbu gsum phyag drug yum le ka dzi dza tis 'khyud pa/ zhabs bzhi klu dang byol song nyi zla la bzhugs pa/ badz+ra he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug yum kro dhi shwa ri dang sbyor ba/ che mchog he ru ka ni theg brgyad zil gyis mnan nas/ rdzogs pa chen po la spyod pa'i brdar zhal dgu pa/ khams bco brgyad bcad nas stong nyid bco brgyad la rol ba'i brdar/ phyag bco brgyad pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyangs nas rnam thar brgyad la rol ba'i zhabs brgyad pa/ yum khro mo gnam zhal ma/ 'khor ba dbyings su dag pas 'khyud pa/ dregs pa can dang*/ rigs drug dang byol song brgyad mnan pas nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o// phur pa phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas 'khyud pa'o// ma mo bla med mngon rdzogs he ru kaḥ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yum nyid zhi mu kha le zhal lnga mas 'khyud pa/ dmod pa lha mchog stobs ldan nag po dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yum 'byung ba lha'i bdag mos 'khyud pa/ 'jig rten mchod bstod lha mchog dregs pa kun 'dul dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/

yum khams gsum spyi 'dul mas 'khyud pa rnams bzhugs pa'o// g.yas su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi sna tshogs yum gyis 'khyud pa/ 'khor rigs bzhi yum bzhi ste brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po rigs bdag dang bcas 'khor dgus bskor ba bzhugs so// gu ru drag po'i g.yon du/ gshin rje dgra nag 'khor dgus bskor ba/ yang g.yon du dpal 'jigs byed rigs bdag dang bcas pa 'khor bcus bskor ba rnams dang*/ mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis lho nub mtshams su thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo gtso 'khor lnga/ zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum rnams snga ma ltar bzhugs so// nub phyogs su kyai rdor rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dgongs pa phyogs gcig par blangs pa/ snying po kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ 'khor gau rī/ tsau rī/ be ta lī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ghasma rī/ spuk+ka sī/ sha wa rī/ ḍoṃ bhi nī phyag mtshan gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pas bskor ba bzhugs/ 'dir yang zhal brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag cing rnam thar brgyad mtshon pa/ phyag bcu drug ni 'pho ba bcu drug dag cing stong nyid bcu drug mtshon la/ zhabs bzhi ni bdud bzhi 'dul zhing bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon/ lha mo brgyad ni/ tshad med bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin can no// yang bde mchog gtsug gi nor bu thabs shes zung du 'jug pa/ 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar po bir+wa pa'i lugs ltar gtso 'khor lnga pa/ g.yas su ma hā mā ya rgyud kyi dngos bstan grub chen ku ku ri pa'i lugs bzhin/ gtso bo thabs shes zung 'jug rigs bdag dang bcas pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ yang g.yas su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma go cha'i lha mo drug gis bskor ba phyug ma rigs bdag dang bcas pa 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba/

yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bde chen gyi lha mo bzhis bskor ba rnams bzhugs la/ mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis dang*/ zur rgyan lha phrug sngar dang 'dra la/ nub byang mtshams na thugs rje chen po a mo gha pā sha don zhags lha lnga rnams bzhugs so// byang phyogs lha snam gyi dbus la ni/ dpal bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ bshad rgyud rnam pa brgyad/ ra li so gnyis rnams la 'dren/ grub chen so sos bkral ba shin tu mang na'ang*/ a bhi dha na mngon brjod bla ma las/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug ces gsungs pa gtso bor mdzad cing*/ rtsa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis po go cha'i lha bcu gnyis dang bcas pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ thog mar mi bskyod pa bde mchog 'khaur lo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis yum rdo rje phag mo dang dus rtag tu bde stong zung du 'jug pa/ zhabs g.yas thabs kyi ngo bo chad pa mya ngan 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas par/ snying rjes sems can blos mi gtong ba'i brdar 'dod chags dus mtshan ma'i chags pa'i gnas skye gnas dang lto ba la reg pa/ zhabs g.yon shes rab kyi ngo bo rtag pa 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas zhing btang ba'i brdar/ zhe sdang khyab 'jug kha sbub pa'i mgo bo phyir bkan te sog phrag snying kha'i thad du brdzis pa/ gti mug gi mun pa bral nas ye shes su rol ba'i brdar glang po che'i pags pa bshus nas gos su bsnams pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug phyag rgyar bzhes pa/ phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pas mtshog mar sna tshogs rdo rje/ byang sems gyen du 'phel bas g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba/ dgos 'dod thams cad ster ba gtsug na yid bzhin nor bu ste/ mdor na sngon gyi bdag po'i lus dang 'khor rgyan longs spyod thams cad thim pa dang*/ dbang byed pa dang*/ bdag po zhes bya ba'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor bsdom pa bzhugs pa'o// rnying ma'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med gtso 'khor lnga/

g.yas su rnam snang bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ yang g.yas su rin 'byung bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis shes rab dang gnyis su med pa'o// g.yon phyogs su snang ba mtha' yas 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ yang g.yon du don yod grub pa bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis rdo rje phag mo la rol bzhin pa bzhugs so// 'khor ni dgu bcu rtsa gnyis ling tshe so so la 'khor mar bzhugs te/ nang gi lha drug cu dang*/ phyi'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis so// de la nang du bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi/ thugs kyi 'khor lo dpa' bo brgyad dang mkha' 'gro brgyad/ gsung gi 'khor lo dpa' bo brgyad dang rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ sku'i 'khor lo yang brgyad tshan gnyis/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams so// phyi la ni dur khrod kyi shing gi rtsa bar gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ rtse mor gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ mchod rten gyi 'gram la gnas pa'i grub chen brgyad/ mtsho brgyad kyi sprin gseb na gnas pa'i klu brgyad rnams so// mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum rnams snga ma bzhin la/ byang shar mtshams na thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ rta mgrin/ sgrol ma gsum bzhugs pa'o// de ltar bang rim 'di la lha bzhi brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga bzhugs so// skabs 'dir dag pa brjod par bya ba ni shin tu mang mod/ dkar chag gong ma rnams na yang phyogs tsam re bzhugs pas/ zur 'go tsam smos na/ bang rim 'di ni gsang sngags gsar rnying gi shin tu rnal 'byor bla med kyi bang rim du bzhugs pas/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam dag sbyor dgos par ji skad du/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jig rten pa dang nyan thos pa ni/ phyi'i dbang gis nang byung zer la/ theg chen pa dang*/

gsang sngags pa ni/ nang gi dbang gis phyi'i 'jog par bzhed pas/ 'di la 'khrul ba'i 'jug tshul dang*/ ma 'khrul ba'i 'jug tshul gnyis/ de yang sems nyid kyi sku'i rang zhal ma mthong zhing*/ 'od zer 'phro ba sgrib byed kyi ma rig pa'i bag chags las/ phyi'i snod dang*/ nang gi sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs la spyod pa ni/ ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba'o// chos sku'i rang zhal gsal zhing 'od 'phro ba'i sgrib byed zad pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa ni dag pa ma 'khrul ba'i snang ba'o// 'khrul pa de ngo ma shes par rgya 'byams ni gzhi 'khor ba pa yin la/ de yang med bzhin du snang ba ste/ sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dpe brgyad bzhin no// 'khrul ba'i rang ngo 'phrod nas/ dag pa'i snang ba cung zad 'char ba ni/ lam dus rnal 'byor pa ste/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes/ sgyu ma la sgyu mar go ba bzhin no// 'khrul pa gtan sangs nas dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig pa ni/ 'bras dus sku gsung thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ste/ gnyid sad pa bzhin no// ngo btsan thabs su sprod pa lta ba phyag rgya chen po ste/ sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la sogs kyi don no// rim gyis ngo sprod pa/ sgom pa bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor te/ rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la sogs kyi don can no// ma dag pa'i snang ba de la'ang*/ las thun mong bas phyogs gcig tu snang ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pas ma 'dres pa so sor snang ba yod pas/ de'i gnyen por/ dag pa'i snang ba/ rten gzhal yas khang na lha gtso 'khor 'jig rten lha mi'i rgyal po'i lugs ltar bkod pa ni/ gu ru zhi ba dang*/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus la bzhugs pa/ 'dir bang rim gyi shar gyi ngos logs la bkod de/ gsang sngags bla med spyi'i rnam pa/ sngon ston pas rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti'i don du gsungs pa de bzhugs so// 'di ni rgyal po'i zhi rgyas kyi las dang*/

nyin par gyi longs spyod dang yang tshul mthun no// yang rgyal pos nyes pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul du/ pha rgyud gu ru drag po bka' brgyad/ gshin rje gshed sogs gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa ni/ 'dir lho phyogs gshin rje'i phyogs zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir du bzhugs pa'o// 'di ni drag po'i las dang mtshan mo'i kun spyod dang mthun no// yang lha ma srin sde brgyad spyod pa ya ma zung sna tshogs kyis thabs log pa staun pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor ni nub kyi phyogs na bzhugs la/ 'di yang rnying ma'i bde mchog gsar ma'i kyai rdor/ ma hā mā yā gdan bzhi rnams kyis mtshon pa'o// gdul bya shin tu gdul bar dka' ba/ lha chen chung ma dang bcas pa 'dul phyir gsungs pa mang yang*/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes bya ba/ 'khor lo sdom pa chen po ni/ byang phyogs kyi ngos logs rnams la bzhugs te/ bstan pa'i chos thams cad kyi phyi mo'am/ bla mar gyur pas so// de yang uta ta re zhes pa/ phyi ma bla ma/ byang phyogs kyi don yin te/ rgyud bla ma dang*/ bde mchog bla ma'i skad dod la gzigs pas mkhyen no// zhar la dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ pha ma gnyis ka'i cha so so ma yin pas/ ma ning dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud te/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad yang 'di dang 'dra bas/ skabs ji ltar rigs par bzhugs so// mdor na bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum gyi gong ma/ rnal 'byor bla med la yang zab khyad rim pa bzhir phye nas g.yas skor du bzhugs la/ spyi khyab tu 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng na/ rtsig pa lnga pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ ka ba/ thog phibs/ pha gu/ drwa phyed/ pu shu/ phyur bu'i rgyan dang bcas pa las/ khyad chos su phyi na dur khrod/ nang na 'khor lo'i rim pa dang bcas pa ni/ phyi ma phyi ma la khyad chos su bzhugs la/ de dag gi dag pa yang phyi'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs/

lcags ris bskor ba'i gling bzhi gling g.yog ri rab kyi steng na/ pho brang bkod pa dang bcas pa sbyong byed/ gzhal yas khang rdo rje'i ra ba nas dbus tog gi bar dang*/ nang du lha gtso 'khor/ phung po lnga/ khams bzhi/ dbang po drug yul drug tshigs bcu la sogs pa'i sbyong byed/ gshed dmar lha lnga lta bu nas/ gsang 'dus rtsa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du bzhugs la/ khyad par la/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dag pa/ 'jig rten chos brgyad snyoms shing*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad lam du byed pa/ skyes bu'i lus kyi bu ga brgyad/ sa rlung gi dur khrod kyi sa gzhi/ chu rlung chu brgyad/ me rlung me brgyad/ rlung gi rlung shing brgyad/ nam mkha'i rlung sprin brgyad/ ye shes kyi rlung grub thob brgyad/ nga rgyal gyi sems phyogs skyong brgyad/ 'dod chags bya tshogs/ zhe sdang zhing skyong brgyad dang lce spyang*/ gti mug klu brgyad/ khams dkar po mchod rten brgyad/ dmar po sha khrag rtsa rkyang ma rdo ra dang*/ ro ma me ris bskor ba ste/ de rnams lam du lon pa'i brda'o// nang du dam tshig dang*/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang*/ ye shes dang*/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo drug gis sdom pa/ dpal bde mchog gi nges don/ sum chos na bzhugs pa'i mtshon byed thams cad bang rim 'di la rim gyis tshang ba ni/ snga ma rnams las lhag pa'i khyad chos gsum pa'o// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bang rim zhes bya ba gsum pa 'di la ni/ rnying ma'i rdor dbyings yang dag he ru ka gsar ma'i rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa/ bshad rgyud cha mthun ngan song sbyong rgyud nas 'byung ba'i dgongs pa blangs pa shar nas mas rim gyis bskor ba lta bu la/ shar gyi ngos logs rnams la ni/ dbus na kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ dga' ba'i tshal du tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can zhal bzhis rnam par brgyan pa'i mdzod spu nas/ ngan song gi rgyud sbyong ba'i 'od zer spro bzhin pas/

stong gsum snang bar mdzad de/ sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon na/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kyis brten pa/ 'khor bcu bzhi la yum bzhi/ phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha so brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ g.yas su mi bskyod pa la/ rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ byams pa sogs bzhi/ phyi nang gi sgo srung gnyis dang bcas pas bskor ba/ yang g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor rdo rje rin chen sogs bzhi dang*/ spos kyi glang po sogs bzhi/ khro bo gnyis dang bcus bskor ba/ g.yon phyogs na snang ba mtha' yas la/ rdo rje chos sogs bzhi/ 'od dpag med sogs bzhi/ khro bo gnyis dang bcus bskor ba/ yang g.yon du don yod grub pa la rdo rje las sogs bzhi/ rdo rje snying po sogs bzhi/ khro bo gnyis dang bcus bskor ba bzhugs so// mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis/ zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding rnams bang rim gong ma gnyis dang 'dra la/ shar lho mtshams na/ phyag na rdo rje slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs bzhugs/ lho phyogs la rdo rje dbyings/ sangs rgyas bde skyong zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ yum sna tshogs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa la/ 'khor rdo rje mche ba ma sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba/ g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyal po/ 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs bzhis bskor ba/ rtogs pa las gsungs pa ltar bzhugs/ yang g.yas su sgrib pa thams cad sel ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dpal mchog rdor sems su grags pa la/ mchod pa'i lha mo me tog ma sogs bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs bzhi ste brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs su sman pa'i rgyal po la/ mtshan legs sogs drug byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar snang byed/ zla ba ltar snang byed dang brgyad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge rigs bdag dang bcas pa la/ byang sems kun tu bzang po sogs drug gis bskor ba bzhugs/

lho nub mtshams na phyag na rdo rje u tsar+yar grags pa bzhugs la/ mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis dang*/ zur rgyan lha phrug gsum gong bzhin bzhugs so// nub phyogs su yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma 'khor rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo dang*/ rdo rje mi pham ma la sogs pa gzungs ma brgyad nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba/ g.yas na khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje shugs can la sogs pa bcus bskor ba/ g.yas na gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba rigs bsgyur ba rigs bdag dang bcas pa 'khor nam sbyin pa bcus bskor ba/ g.yon phyogs su tshe dpag med lha dgu grub chen dze tā ri'i lugs dang*/ yang g.yon du spyan ras gzigs yum yig drug ma/ sras nor bu 'dzin pa gsum la/ 'khor mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma sogs dang*/ me tog ma sogs bcus bskor ba bzhugs/ nub byang mtshams su phyag na rdo rje gtum po ras chung lugs bzhugs la/ mchod lha bcu drug zur rgyan lha phrug gsum gong ltar bzhugs so// byang phyogs la mi 'khrugs pa gtso 'khor bcu gsum gzungs nas byung ba ltar bzhugs/ rdor dbyings yang dag he ru ka 'khor dgus bskor ba/ g.yas su phyag na rdo rje rigs lngas bskor ba/ g.yon phyogs la khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa/ de'i g.yon na rta mgrin 'khor bzhis bskor ba/ mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis/ byang shar na phyag na rdo rje 'khor chen dpa' gcig zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum yang gong ltar bzhugs so// bang rim 'di la lha sum brgya rtsa bzhi bzhugs la/ 'di dag las 'ga' zhig sngar bya spyod du grags kyang*/ lha la rigs lnga'i rnam gzhag dang*/ phyi'i mngon byang lnga dang phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs yod pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad du nges pa ltar rnal 'byor rgyud du 'grel pa'i rgya gzhung khungs thub la brten pa'o// bzhi pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bang rim la bzhugs tshul la/

rgyud 'di'i rtsa ba'i rgyud ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di rnam snang gangs chen mtsho zhes bya bar sangs rgyas pa'i rnam par thar pa zhig 'byung ba de'i dbang du mdzad nas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku bzhi'i ngo bos rigs lngar sprul te/ 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ rnying ma ltar na thub pa rigs drug tu yang sprul pas/ de'i mtshon byed phyogs rer sku lnga lnga te nyi shu/ 'khor zhi bas 'dul ba la byang sems nye ba'i sras phyogs re la gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ drag pos 'dul ba la khro bo gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ spyod lam gyis 'dul ba gnas brtan bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba la dharma ta la sogs pa'i 'khor sna tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ spyir spyod rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ phyag rdor dbang skur gnyis las bod na mi bzhugs pas/ 'dir sangs rgyas stong po lha grangs la bkod pa'o// shar phyogs dbus kyi ling tsher/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po rgyal ba shākya thub pa mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba'i sku/ dzam bu'i chu gser ltar brjid pa'i skum khru gang pa la/ g.yas na rgyal tshab ma pham byams pa mgon po klu shing gi steng na ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ston pa nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu zhal gyis bzhes bzhin pa dang*/ g.yas na khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pas bstan pa srung bzhin pa dang*/ g.yon na byang sems kun bzang rgyal ba'i bka' nod bzhin pas rin chen gang bu 'dzin pa/ yang g.yon na khams gsum rnam rgyal mda' gzhus mi bsrun pa la bsnun pa ste bzhis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi lha snam la ston pa mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ de nas skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon du mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ yang chos 'chad mdzad pa ste bzhi bzhugs/ rgyab kyi ling tshe la sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang brgyad cu bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/

bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ gser thub dang*/ 'od srung dang*/ byams pa dang*/ seng ge dang*/ rab gsal dang*/ thub pa me tog gnyis la sogs pa/ bskal bzang dang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs mdzad pa'i bstod pa ltar sbyar ro// 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzhi/ rgyal chen bzhi/ dharma ta la/ hwa shang te 'khor drug ka ba phyi nang gi mchod lha brgyad gong ma dang 'dra la/ zur thung la lha mo bzhi/ shar lho mtshams na lha'i drang srong me tog zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum gong ma ltar bzhugs so// lho phyogs bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas stong gi sku srung ba por zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ dbang rtags kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje sputa pa la'i steng du 'dzin pa/ khro rgyal mi g.yo ba g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bskor ba/ g.yas kyi snam bu la ston pa sangs rgyas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ yang skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang chos 'chad mdzad pa/ rgyab kyi ling tsher mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can nyis brgya dang brgyad cu 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzhi/ 'khor lnga/ mchod lha brgyad/ zur thung gi mchod lha bzhi sngar bzhin la/ lho nub mtshams su gnon sbyin gyi drang srong bsod nams lhun po/ zur rgyan lha phrug gsum snga ma bzhin no// nub phyogs dbus su bstan pa'i bdag po shākya seng ge g.yas su 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar ba/ khro bo gshin rje gshed/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs khro bo rta mgrin/ lha snam g.yas phyogs la/ ston pa mchog sbyin mdzad pa dang skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon la mnyam bzhag chos 'chad can/ rgyab kyi ling tsher mnyam bzhag can nyis brgya brgyad cu/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzhi/ 'khor bdun/ mchod lha bzhi tshan gsum snga ma bzhin la/ nub byang mtshams su klu'i drang srong me sgron/

zur rgyan lha phrug sngar bzhin no// byang phyogs dbus su rgyal ba shākya'i tog g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po rin po che'i myug gu 'dzin pa/ khro chen dbyug pa sngon po/ g.yon na sgrib pa rnam sel po ti 'dzin pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ g.yas kyi snam bu la ston pa mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ yang skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon du mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ yang chos 'chad mdzad pa/ rgyab kyi ling tsher sangs rgyas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can nyis brgya dang brgyad cu la 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan sdug zhi ba'i zhal dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes bzang ldan rgyal ba/ 'byor ldan ston pa yon tan phung po sogs bskal pa bzang po'i mdo sde las 'byung ba ltar bzhugs so// 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzhi 'khor lnga/ ka ba phyi nang gi mchod lha bzhi bzhi/ zur thung gi lha mo bzhi/ byang shar mtshams su mi'i drang srong ri ṣi/ zur rgyan gyi lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum rnams bzhugs so// de ltar bang rim 'di la lha stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya drug cu bzhugs pa'o// phyogs bzhi'i gtso bo la/ rgyan sna bzhi dang gter chen po'i bum pa chab kyi nang nas 'khrungs pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi lo 'bras las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bzhin pas spras pa'o// lnga pa bya rgyud kyi bang rim/ shar phyogs dbus kyi ling tshe la/ rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum du gyur cing*/ rgyal ba nyid kyis khro ba'i rims nad dang*/ nyer 'tshe sel ba la mchog tu bsngags pa lha mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ g.yas na 'jigs pa dang nyam nga ba kun la skyob par bsngags pa lha mo 'od zer can zhal gsum phyag drug ma rgyal ba lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ g.yon du nyon mongs kyi dug sel ba la bsngags pa dug sel ma zhal gsum phyag drug rgyab yol la rin 'byung gnyis/ g.yas g.yon gyi snam bu la rig ma bcu drug te pi wang ma sogs bzhi/

gzugs rdo rje ma sogs bzhi/ bzhad ma sogs bzhi/ me tog ma sogs bzhi bzhugs/ ka ba la byang sems bzhi/ nang sogs la lha mo bzhi/ zur thung la lha mo brgyad/ shar lhor lcags kyu ma/ zur rgyan la lha phrug nam mkha' lding gsum bzhugs so// lho phyogs lha snam dbus ma la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje las 'khrungs te 'gro ba ma lus pa 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i lha mo phyag brgyad sgrol ma rigs bdag dang bcas pa/ g.yas su rig sngags byad stems mthu thams cad bzlog pa la bsngags pa'i gtsug gtor gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ g.yon na rgyal ba kun gyi thugs myur du bskul ba la bsngags pa'i rje btsun ma tsun dā zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rgyab tu rin 'byung gnyis snam bu la rig ma bcu drug mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis/ lho nub tu rdo rje zhags pa/ zur rgyan gong bzhin bzhugs so// nub phyogs la dbus su dgra dang chom rkun dmag dpung bzlog pa la mchog tu bsngags pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas na srid gsum mnga' bdag ma rungs pa tshar gcod cing*/ bde legs 'byung ba gtso bor gyur pa'i e ka dzā ṭi phyag brgyad ma/ g.yon na gdon bgegs 'joms pa la phul du phyin pa'i stong chen rab 'joms/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rgyab na rin 'byung gnyis/ snam bu la rig ma bcu drug mchod lha brgyad tshan gnyis/ nub byang sgo ba rdo rje lcags sgrog zur rgyan gsum gong bzhin bzhugs/ byang phyogs dbus na 'gro ba'i dbul phongs thams cad sel ba'i nor rgyun ma phyag drug ma/ g.yas na tshe'i dngos grub ster ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ yang g.yas su 'khor 'das dbang du sdud pa'i ku ru ku le/ g.yon du mi mthun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i rig sngags thams cad kyi rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma/

rgyab tu rin 'byung gnyis snam bu la rnam rgyal gyi 'khor brgyad/ g.yas g.yon du rig ma bcu drug ka ba'i lha mo bzhi dang byang sems bzhi/ zur thung gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ byang shar mtshams su sgo ba rdo rje dril bu lugs su byon pa/ zur rgyan lha phrug nam mkha' lding 'phrul las grub pa ste/ yongs sgril bang rim 'di la lha brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so// de ltar rgyud sde'i bang rim bzhi po la/ rnying ma'i bka' brgyad rig 'dzin dang bcas pa/ gsar ma'i rgyud sde bzhi'i gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor tshang la ma 'khrugs pa gtso bo rnams lugs ma/ 'khor rnams 'phrul ma mchod lha rnams/ rdor dbyings gsang 'dus mnyam sbyor gdan bzhi sogs mthun pa rnams bsdebs la/ zhal phyag nges brjod bla ma'i lugs ltar bkod la/ stong snam gyi grwa la 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas ci rigs par bzhugs pa'ang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi'ang kha skong dang*/ yang mdo sde nas zhing bkod dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas brgya phrag gcig lhag pa'ang bzhugs la/ bang rim 'og ma 'dir phar phyin mngon rtogs rgyan nas gsungs pa'i sher phyin gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum po'ang nges par tshang ba ste/ rgyud sde bzhi mdo dang bcas pa'i go rim dang lha grangs kyang*/ snga ma rnams las lhag tu gyur pa 'di ni khyad par bzhi pa'o// de nas bang rim drug pa ya pad dang ma pad 'khor ma la/ 'dab ma nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug pa ni/ phyogs re la yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhis mtshan pa rin po che'i khri 'phang dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mi mjed lta bur yang rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i mtsho las skyes pa'i smon lam gyi pad+ma'i ge sar la gnas pa dang*/ sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba rin po che'i khrir spungs pa las lhun gyis grub pa'i mtshon byed can bzhugs pa'o// bang rim bdun pa la ni/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma/

mdo sde dang gsang sngags phyi nang gsar rnying rnams las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ rang bzhin rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi dbang bcu dang stobs bcu la sogs pa'i ngo bo/ rnam pa gdul bya'i don du khro bo bcu/ srung ma drug cu/ pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ mdor na ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa ji ltar mthun gyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul can/ mtshan lan re thos pas kyang*/ log 'dren tshar gcod cing*/ dgra bgegs zil gyis mnan nas mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub na/ yid la dran zhing gsol ba btab na/ 'phral dang yun gyi bde skyid thams cad skad cig la ster zhing bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig can sha stag phyogs re la rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi thugs las sprul pa'i dpal mgon nag po chen po lcam dang bka' nyan du bcas pa dang*/ chos sgrub pa'i gang zag la 'tsho ba sbyor bar rgyal ba'i bka' nod pa gnod sbyin sde dpon 'khor bcas dang*/ gdug pa can gyi klu 'dul phyir du rgyal ba nyid kyis sprul zhing mdo sngags bstan pa longs spyod kyis spel ba'i thabs tshul can klu chen brgyad po re re bzhin 'khor brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams dang*/ shar phyogs su zhi ba'i las kyis dri za'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur zhing bstan pa skyong ba'i yul 'khor bsrung*/ lho phyogs na drag po'i las kyis gshin rje btul nas bstan pa skyong ba 'phags skyes po/ nub phyogs na dbang gi las kyis klu rnams bsdus nas bstan pa skyong ba spyan mi bzang*/ byang phyogs na rgyas pa'i las kyis tshe dang longs spyod spel nas bstan pa skyong ba rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras rnams bzhugs la/ 'di rnams kyi bkod pa'i bye brag kyang*/ skyob pa nyid kyi bzhed pas/ gtso bor phrin las bzhi po sgrub pa ste/ g.yon pa rnams ni rang rang gi rtogs pa ltar khros shing rngam pa 'jigs su rung ba drag po'i rnam pa gtso che/

lha mo rnams 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i nyams dang yang ldan/ gnod sbyin rnams rgyas pa'i gar nyams shas che/ klu 'khor brgyad po ni zhi ba'i nyams shas che ba ste/ rin chen pad+mo'i sdong po 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rtsed 'jo'i tshul brgyad kyi gar nyams dang ldan pas 'degs shing*/ sprin chen pos khyim nye bar dkrig pa mgo bo dgu pa zhal nang du blta ba las/ cung zad thad zhal du'ang gzigs pa/ 'brug gi mgo bo skad 'byin pa'i stang ka can/ kha na glog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sel zhing*/ dngos grub kyi char rin po che sna tshogs 'beb bzhin pa/ 'phags lam yan lag gi 'khor brgyad brgyad kyis bskor bar bzhugs pa'o// shar phyogs pad+ma zlum po 'khor ba'i bar la bzhugs pa'i gnas kyi zlum rdzing g.yas 'khyil dang po la/ gter gyi bdag po dpal mgon yab yum/ 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su a phyi chos kyi sgron ma chibs kyi steng na rang gi bstan pa tshul bzhin srung ba'i 'dzum khro'i nyams kyis 'gying zhing 'khor bzhis bskor ba/ g.yas na rnam thos sras seng ge la bcibs pa/ dzam lha dang rta bdag brgyad kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas 'khor brgyad ldan bzhugs/ g.yon 'khyil dang por dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa mngon byung rgyud nas gsungs pa bya rog gdong seng gdong can gnyis dang bcas pa la 'khor bcus bskor ba/ g.yon du dpal ldan lha mo la/ chu srin gdong ma dang*/ sa'i lha mos bskor ba/ sa'i lha mo'i 'khor bco lnga te/ gter bdag brgyad/ tshe ring mched lnga/ a phyi mched gsum bzhugs/ g.yon du klu rgyal pad+ma chen po 'khor brgyad dang ldan pa zlum tshigs dbus mar glang po che gnyis/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po yul 'khor srung rnams bzhugs pa'o// lho phyogs g.yas 'khyil dang po la/ gur gyi mgon po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa nas gsungs pa 'khor lha brgyad bya khyung dang dgu/

ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa mgon po nag po'i rgyud nas gsungs pa 'khor lnga dang bcas pa/ g.yas su gnod sbyin 'brog gnas rigs bdag dang bcas pa 'khor dgu dang ldan pa/ klu rgyal pad+ma 'khor brgyad ldan bzhugs/ g.yon 'khyil dang por/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol 'dod khams dbang phyug rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud nas gsungs pa/ chu srin gdong ma dang bcas pa 'khor bcus bskor ba/ g.yon du lha'i drang srong khyab 'jug mgo dgu pa rigs bdag phyag na rdo rje dang bcas pa 'khor gza' dgus brtan pa ri byis bskor ba/ g.yon du klu rgyal dung skyong 'khor brgyad dang bcas pa/ zlum tshigs dbus mar rta mchog gnyis/ lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po rigs bdag dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'o// nub phyogs zlum rdzing g.yas 'khyil dang po la/ bka' gdams pa'i mgon por grags pa legs ldan dang*/ ber nag can 'khor gcig legs ldan gyi 'khor brgyad/ mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pa'i bgegs dbang rgyal po tshogs bdag glang sna can 'khor brgyad ldan/ g.yas su klu rgyal 'jog po 'khor brgyad ldan/ g.yon 'khyil dang por lha mo bong bzhon ma chu srin gdong ma gnyis 'khor bdun ldan/ dzam lha la 'khor brgyad ldan/ zlum tshigs dbus mar rma bya gnyis/ rgyal chen mig mi bzang rigs bdag dang bcas pa bzhugs/ byang phyogs zlum rdzing gi g.yas 'khyil dang po la mgon po gri gug trad shad gnyis/ gri gug gi 'khor brgyad/ g.yas su ljon pa rta mgon can 'khor nyi shus bskor ba/ g.yas su klu rgyal nor rgyas 'khor brgyad ldan/ g.yon 'khyil dang por dpal ldan ma dbu bcu bdun ma/ rdo rje legs pa/ chu srin gdong ma 'khor bcu dgus bskor ba/ g.yon du gnod sbyin a pa ra tsit+ta 'khor bcu bzhi/ g.yon du klu rgyal ma dros pa 'khor brgyad ldan/ zlum tshigs dbus mar shang shang gnyis/ byang phyogs skyong mdzad rnam mang thos sras dgra bgegs la snun pa'i mdung dang*/

dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du rtsol bar mdzad pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams bzhugs so// bang rim 'di la theg chen sems bskyed byams dang snying rje'i rta pho la zhes sogs kyis mtshon pa'i don rnams tshang ste zur tsam mo// de ltar na chos skyong bang rim la lha gsum brgya nga bzhi bzhugs pas/ spyir nyis stong brgyad brgya bzhugs la/ rigs bdag gi lha dang*/ mi 'jigs bzhi dang so so rig bzhi mtshon byed kyi/ glang chen sogs grangs su brtsis na bcu phrag du ma lhag bcas bzhugs pa'o// 'di'i rnam pa blta bas mi ngoms shing dad pa skye ba'i gnas su mngon pa ni/ phyi khang rtseg mchod rten rgyal ba'i zhing*/ nang lha sku rab 'byams tshad med pa til gyi gang bu til gyis gang ba ltar bzhugs la/ khyad par phyogs re re nas bltas pa'i tshe/ lha bab kyi mchod rten dang mtshungs la/ zur gyi lha rnams ni nam mkha'i dbyings su 'gro ba 'dul phyir sprul te byon pa ltar mngon te/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ grub chen nā ro pa'i gzigs snang ltar/ sgrub pa po skal ldan gyi mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa dang 'dra la/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs rnams ni/ 'gro drug gi gnas la dus rtag tu gzigs pa/ su ni skal pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan 'gro las 'thon/ su ni byang chub la gzhol snyam du nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du thugs brtse ba chen po 'ba' zhig gis dgongs pa ltar bzhugs/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams ni/ bstan pa'i dgra bo 'dul ba la dpa' ma zhum pa'i nyams dang ldan/ lha'i bu rnams ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'gro don mdzad dgos par tshigs su bcad pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul bzhin pas bzhugs/ thub pa drang srong rnams shis pa brjod pa'i tshul dkyil 'khor gyi lha ji snyed pa ni rang rang gi mngon par rtogs pa dang mthun pas/ gzhung gzhan la blta bar bya zhing*/ mtshan rnams dkar chag gsung 'bum nang du dang*/

gzhan rnying pa na'ang yod pas/ 'dir ha cang yang mang dogs ma bkod la/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po ni/ rin po che'i rigs thams cad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ pha rol dmag gi dpung bzlog pa ltar chas su bzhugs shing 'gying stabs dang ldan pa/ dar gyi gos rnam pa mang po'i lhab lhub can/ rlung gis cung zad bskyod pa'i tshul du yod pa/ dar dpyangs kyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ sku la 'od 'bar zhing gzi brjid chen po dang ldan te/ dpa' zhing 'gran pas rgyal ba'i dam chos skyong ba'i tshul du bzhugs so// bad gdong rnams la rin po che ma ra ka taṃ gi phra btab pa ni/ me'i phung po ltar gsal zhing 'bar la/ rin po che'i phra bkod brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams ni mtshan mo sprin med nam mkha' la rgyu skar gyi tshogs ltar rnam par bkra'o// de la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i chun 'phyang gi drwa ba nyis rim du 'khor bas kun tu mdzes pa ni dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang dang 'dra la/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas rin chen tog gi bar thams cad dzam+bu'i chu gser gyi char pas khebs pa ni/ bskal bzang rol mtsho'i dbus na rin po che'i ri bo ltar mngon par mtho zhing brjid pa'o// bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis de kho na bzhin du gyur cig dkon mchog bden pa'i don gyis de kho na bzhin du gyur cig mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi nus pas de kho na bzhin du gyur cig dkar chag dngos grub char 'bebs la/ kun dga'i phrin las khyams chen du zhugs te/ rin chen bang mdzod la ji ltar 'dod bzhin rtsen pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/// /
